closed_recent.body:
## 🚀 Background Description

#400 defined the desktop delivery design for Windows and macOS. The Windows implementation has landed through #639, #643 and #666. This feature completes the macOS side so that research users can install, configure, run and update ScienceDiscovery without using a terminal-based source workflow.

**Current status (2026-11-17):** PR #1156 has been merged into `main` as `5058334f09a7b28c7c56dbbdb199b2adf13adf74`. The 47-commit feature branch was squashed on merge, producing a tree byte-identical to reviewed head `43d54632`. Implementation and code review are complete; this issue remains open for the unchecked release-acceptance criteria below.

Related: #400 (parent delivery design), #666 (Windows shell counterpart), #34 (desktop window origin).

### Feature scope

- Adapt the shared Electron shell to macOS menus, window and quit behavior, data/log locations, system proxy and process-group lifecycle.
- Add a main-process Seatbelt startup probe and a sandbox-health status row. *(Updated by #1336, 2026-11-26: a probe failure no longer blocks startup — the bilingual standalone failure page was retired; the status row in Settings › Connection › Sandbox network is the single surface.)*
- Provide reproducible macOS payload assembly, DMG/ZIP packaging, Developer ID signing, notarization and staple.
- Support first acquisition through DMG and visible, prompt-only updates through notarized ZIP and `latest-mac.yml`.
- Provide in-app data cleanup plus an offline uninstall/reset companion script.
- Preserve Windows behavior through the `win_desktop/` → `application/` rename and packaging/CI updates.

### Target user journey

1. Download the signed DMG.
2. Drag ScienceDiscovery into Applications.
3. Choose the data directory on first launch.
4. Let the shell run Seatbelt and runtime startup checks in the background; sandbox health is shown in the Settings status row. *(Updated by #1336: a failed probe continues unsandboxed; the standalone error page is retired.)*
5. Configure the model and run a local scientific-research task.
6. Install later updates through the visible notarized ZIP/OTA flow.

## Design Ideas

### Architecture

Reuse JiuwenSwarm as the Agent foundation. This feature connects the scientific-research services and productizes them for macOS desktop users; it does not create a second Agent stack.

```text
Electron shell
Windows, menus, first-run wizard and process management
        ↓
Scientific-research services
API, task execution and runtime adaptation
        ↓
JiuwenSwarm
Existing Skills, Tools and Agent capabilities
```

Seatbelt is checked before execution and blocks entry to the main UI on failure. Data and logs are written outside the signed `.app` so the bundle remains read-only.

### Runtime and packaging entries

`application/` is one shared shell, not two applications. `main.ts` is the common Electron runtime entry; `platform/index.ts` reads `process.platform` and dispatches platform decisions.

```text
application/src/main.ts
        ↓
platform/index.ts
        ├── win32.ts    Windows paths, venv, tray and window behavior
        └── darwin.ts   macOS paths, venv, Dock and menu behavior
```

Runtime entry and packaging entry are separate concerns:

| Platform | Runtime entry | Packaging entry |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | `application/src/main.ts` → `platform/index.ts` → `platform/win32.ts` | `scripts/package-sd-windows.sh`; payload assembly defaults to `win32-x64` |
| macOS | `application/src/main.ts` → `platform/index.ts` → `platform/darwin.ts` | `application/scripts/build-mac.sh`; clean machines start with `build-mac-from-scratch.sh`; payload uses `darwin-arm64` |

### Key decisions and constraints

| Decision | Implementation | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Platform facade | Shared types, `win32`, `darwin` and dispatch under `application/src/platform/` | One application with isolated, testable platform decisions |
| Sandbox | Seatbelt by default; #1336 adds an installation-level direct-execution opt-in (off by default), and a probe failure now continues unsandboxed with the status row in Settings › Connection › Sandbox network | Default installs stay sandboxed; unsandboxed operation is an explicit, documented choice rather than a silent degradation |
| Bundle integrity | Redirect writes out of `.app`; copy-mode bootstrap; propagate `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE`, including to MCP sidecars | A signed/notarized bundle must remain read-only |
| venv relocation | Convert build-host absolute symlinks to relative links into the bundled Python tree | Matches POSIX venv structure and makes the payload relocatable |
| Desktop runtime | v1 uses the build machine's uv-installed Python, as the Windows chain does. Darwin entries in `scripts/binary-release/runtimes.json` are for auditing and a possible future single-file edition; desktop assembly does not consume them in v1 | Aligns the delivery record with the actual DMG/ZIP payload |
| Signing modes | Ad-hoc smoke builds by default; Developer ID + notarization + staple require `SD_MAC_SIGN=1` | Prevents smoke builds from silently using release credentials |
| Updates | Notarized ZIP + `latest-mac.yml`, prompt-only, backend drain before restart | ZIP is the electron-updater carrier; DMG is acquisition-only |
| Architecture | arm64 only for v1 | Intel/x64 timing is deferred until there is concrete demand |
| CI boundary | Windows desktop distribution is covered by CI; macOS packaging and real-Mac acceptance currently rely on local evidence | Makes the current verification boundary explicit |

### Platform behavior

| Area | Windows | macOS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Installation | NSIS / `setup.exe` | DMG drag-install; notarized ZIP for updates |
| Runtime layout | `Scripts/`, `python.exe`, DLL | `bin/`, `python`, symlinks |
| Execution safety | Existing Provider path | Seatbelt by default; explicit direct-execution opt-in (#1336) |
| System proxy | Registry | `scutil --proxy` |
| Uninstall | Uninstaller + optional deep cleanup | Trash + in-app cleanup + offline uninstall/reset script |

Both platforms share the Electron shell, Node services, Python runtime and JiuwenSwarm.

### Uninstall and reset behavior

The Help menu provides in-app uninstall/data cleanup. `application/scripts/uninstall-mac.command` adds four offline modes: full uninstall, app-only uninstall, data reset and read-only path inspection. It backs up selected critical data, moves deleted items to Trash and checks for leftover backend processes. The script is a separate Release asset and is not embedded in the DMG/ZIP.

### UI and failure states

The packaged desktop flow does not display the SPA `SetupWizard` self-check step. The main process probes Seatbelt once per session in the background: the verdict — success or failure — is surfaced as a status row in Settings › Connection › Sandbox network. A failure no longer blocks initialization; the standalone bilingual error page was retired with it (owner decision recorded in #1336, 2026-11-26).

The SPA self-check component remains covered by component tests, but its pending, success and in-component failure renders are not part of the packaged desktop user journey and are therefore not presented as product screenshots here.

**Sandbox health status row (设置 › 连接 › 沙箱网络)**

The standalone Seatbelt error page (`seatbelt-error.html`) and its launch-blocking gate were retired in #1336 (2026-11-26): a failed probe no longer replaces the window — the app continues unsandboxed while the status row shows the failure with actionable diagnostics, and the opt-in direct-execution tier keeps its per-run confirmation armed.

### Non-goals for this delivery

- No Keychain/safeStorage migration; retain AES-256-GCM + `0600` file-based secrets.
- No simultaneous Intel/x64 release.
- No `.pkg` installer.
- No second Agent framework or duplicate JiuwenSwarm capability stack.
- The website `/install` Mac card and telemetry changes are outside this repository.

## Involved Public APIs

No backend public API changes. The shell exposes `sdShell.platform` through preload so the renderer reads the main-process platform value rather than relying on UA sniffing. The platform facade is internal to the shell, and the backend start-stack contract remains unchanged.

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules

| Module | Relevance and required verification |
| --- | --- |
| `application/scripts/assemble-backend.mjs`, `application/scripts/lib/assemble-platform.mjs` | Add platform-aware payload assembly; Windows remains the default dialect. Verify payload layout and required files for both platforms. |
| `scripts/binary-release/runtimes.json` | Contains darwin audit entries that desktop assembly does not consume in v1; do not treat them as evidence of a separately pinned desktop Python runtime. |
| `application/scripts/after-pack-trim-locales.cjs` | Supports Windows dash-pak and macOS `.lproj` layouts; verify both packaging paths. |
| `scripts/package-sd-windows.sh` | Supports `application/` with compatibility fallback; Windows install, upgrade and uninstall require regression coverage. |
| `application/src/main.ts`, `stack.ts`, `proxy.ts`, `sandbox-probe.ts`, `updater.ts`, `uninstall-data.ts` | Own shell lifecycle, networking, safety, updates and cleanup; verify platform dispatch and failure paths. |
| `apps/desktop/src/views/SetupWizard.tsx` and text contracts | The packaged shell opens this wizard at model configuration and skips its self-check step; verify that handoff and retain component-test coverage for the non-packaged flow. |
| `services/api` MCP sidecar launch | Propagates `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE` into the SDK's minimal child-process environment; verify child-process behavior remains unchanged on other platforms. |

## Test Design and Test Plan

### Test environment

Existing local development-machine evidence was collected on:

**macOS (arm64)**

| Item | Environment |
| --- | --- |
| Model | MacBook Pro, MacBookPro17,1 |
| Chip | Apple M1, 4 performance cores + 4 efficiency cores |
| Memory | 8 GB |
| Architecture | arm64, Apple Silicon |
| OS | macOS 14.8.9, build 23J631 |
| Node.js | v24.22.1 in the local terminal |

**Windows (x64)**

| Item | Environment |
| --- | --- |
| Model | Lenovo laptop |
| CPU | AMD Ryzen 7 5800H, 8 cores / 16 threads, 3.2 GHz, 16 MB L3 |
| Memory | 32 GB (2×16 GB DDR4-3200, dual channel) |
| GPU | NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Laptop GPU (8 GB GDDR6) + integrated Radeon |
| Disk | SK hynix 1TB NVMe SSD |
| OS | Windows 11 Pro 64-bit, Build 26300 |

These environments document existing local evidence; they do not replace release acceptance on a clean macOS machine.

### Measured timing data (v0.4.0)

Wall-clock measurements captured on the machines above. First initialization excludes network downloads (the runtime ships inside the package); first-conversation latency includes the round trip to the connected model API.

| Platform | Installer size | Install time | First initialization | Warm start | First conversation | Uninstall |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (arm64, DMG) | 578 MB | 43s | 12.3s | 7.2s | 9.8s | — |
| Windows (x64, setup.exe) | 587 MB | 1min30s | 11.4s | 10.5s | 10.6s | 25.4s |

> *Reference measurements of WorkSwarm on the same machines:*
>
> **macOS (arm64, MacBook Pro M1, 8 GB)**
>
> | Version | Installer size | Install time | First initialization | Warm start | First conversation | Uninstall |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | WorkSwarm v0.2.6 | 497 MB | 10s | 7s | 6s | 9.7s | — |
> | WorkSwarm v0.2.9 | 834 MB | 12s | 6.7s | 6.9s | 7s | — |
>
> **Windows (x64, Ryzen 7 5800H, 32 GB)**
>
> | Version | Installer size | Install time | First initialization | Warm start | First conversation | Uninstall |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | WorkSwarm v0.2.6 | 352 MB | 43s | 14.1s | 11.3s | 10.8s | 4.6s |
> | WorkSwarm v0.2.9 | 594 MB | 2min4s (second install 1min20s) | 10s | 8.7s | 7.2s | 6s |

Per-stage screenshots:

| Stage | macOS | Windows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Install | ![macOS install 43s](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/01-mac-install-43s.jpg) | ![Windows install 1min30s](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/06-win-install-1min30s.jpg) |
| First initialization | ![macOS first init 12.3s](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/02-mac-first-init-12.3s.jpg) | ![Windows first init 11.4s](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/07-win-first-init-11.4s.jpg) |
| First conversation | ![macOS first conversation 9.8s](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/03-mac-first-conversation-9.8s.jpg) | ![Windows first conversation 10.6s](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/08-win-first-conversation-10.6s.jpg) |
| Warm start | ![macOS warm start 7.2s](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/04-mac-warm-start-7.2s.jpg) | ![Windows warm start 10.5s](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/09-win-warm-start-10.5s.jpg) |
| Uninstall | ![macOS uninstall 6s](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/05-mac-uninstall-6s.jpg) | ![Windows uninstall 25.4s](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/10-win-uninstall-25.4s.jpg) |

Full-journey recordings (install → first initialization → first conversation → warm start → uninstall):

- macOS: [MP4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/11-mac-full-recording.mp4) · [GIF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/11-mac-full-recording.gif)
- Windows: [MP4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/12-win-full-recording.mp4) · [GIF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qingkwl/sciencediscovery/assets/issue-1165-evidence/docs/issue-assets/12-win-full-recording.gif)

> **Version-over-version improvement (v0.3.0 → v0.4.0, Windows)** — same Lenovo Windows machine as above. All six metrics improved:
>
> | Metric | v0.3.0 | v0.4.0 | Improvement |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | Installer size | 791 MB | 587 MB | **smaller by 204 MB (25.8%)** |
> | Install | 2min | 1min30s | faster by 30s (25.0%) |
> | First initialization | 18s | 11.4s | faster by 6.6s (36.7%)
> | Warm start | 17s | 10.5s | faster by 6.5s (38.2%) |
> | First conversation | 26s | 10.6s | **faster by 15.4s (59.2%)**|
> | Uninstall | 30s | 25.4s | faster by 4.6s (15.3%) |

### Test matrix

| Dimension | What must be protected | Verification method |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shell functionality | Start, stop, update, uninstall and Windows/macOS branch behavior | `pnpm --dir application test` |
| Compile and build integrity | Type, syntax and shell build failures | `pnpm --dir application typecheck` and `pnpm --dir application build` |
| Platform isolation | Shared dispatch without cross-platform regressions | `application/src/platform/index.ts`, `win32.ts`/`darwin.ts` branch tests and `shell-platform.ts` compatibility tests |
| Sandbox security | Seatbelt existence, execution, spawn failure, signals, exit codes, timeout and failure-verdict behavior | `sandbox-probe.ts` real probe plus `sandbox-probe.test.ts` decision and exception tests. *(Updated by #1336: the verdict feeds the Settings status row; the fail-closed gate on it is retired.)* |
| UI and diagnostics | Model-configuration handoff, zh/en copy and sandbox-health status-row diagnostics; the packaged flow must not show the SPA self-check step | `apps/desktop/tests/app-model-setup-render.test.ts` (the packaged-handoff guard: scenarios × zh/en, injecting `sdShell: { wizardIntroDone: true }`), `setup-wizard.test.tsx` (non-packaged component states) and component-render review |
| Packaged runtime completeness | Python, dependencies, symlinks, patches and bytecode | `build-mac.sh` and `pyc-budget.test.ts`: A1 import smoke, A1b runtime probe, A2 required files, A6 bytecode, path, symlink and patch-chain gates |
| Build reproducibility | A fresh Mac/clone can assemble and package without undocumented machine state | `build-mac-from-scratch.sh` followed by `build-mac.sh` local gates |
| Apple distribution checks | App and DMG signatures, notarization, staple and Gatekeeper assessment | `codesign`, `notarytool`, `stapler` and `spctl` on both artifacts |
| Startup timing guard | A healthy launch never silently turns into a hang: every component reaches its ready/healthy event within its hang ceiling | `perf-gate.mjs` two-layer gate in CI (`macos-desktop` job, `--hang-only`): real packaged `.app` launch via `perf-smoke-mac.sh`, first-run `shell.log` judged against `perf-budget.json` hang ceilings (H1-H9); measured log uploaded as `perf-smoke-shell-log-<sha>` artifact — landed via #1374 |

Unit tests with fake process spawns verify decision logic; component renders verify UI states; local packaging verifies the build chain. None of these alone substitutes for the remaining real-machine release acceptance.

The timing guard was added after the matrix above: it is the machine-checked layer for the "silent hang" class, judging the same logs the real-machine acceptance reads.

## Acceptance Criteria

### Engineering checks

- [x] `pnpm --dir application test` passes for the merged implementation.
- [x] `pnpm --dir application typecheck` passes for the merged implementation.
- [x] Local macOS packaging gates and the signing/notarization chain have been exercised.
- [x] The from-scratch packaging flow has passed clean-room reproduction checks.

### Release acceptance

- [ ] **Clean-machine macOS acceptance:** download DMG → drag install → wizard → complete a small task, with no unexpected Gatekeeper prompt; `spctl` accepts both the `.app` and DMG.
- [ ] **Sandbox health visibility on the release package:** when Seatbelt fails, the app continues unsandboxed, the status row in Settings › Connection › Sandbox network shows the failure with actionable diagnostics, and direct execution remains an explicit opt-in. *(Rewritten by #1336, 2026-11-26: the original fail-closed red line — never reaching the main UI on a failed probe — was retired together with the standalone error page.)*
- [ ] **Signed bundle remains read-only:** first and second runs write nothing into `.app`; re-verify with `codesign --verify --deep --strict`.
- [ ] **Quit semantics:** Cmd+Q drains and stops the complete stack, including detached JiuwenSwarm processes; no orphan processes or occupied ports remain.
- [x] **Windows regression:** install, upgrade and uninstall still work after the `application/` rename and payload-gate changes. (Evidence: the Windows measurement table above — setup.exe 587 MB, install 1min30s, first initialization 11.4s, warm start 10.5s, first conversation 10.6s, uninstall 25.4s — with per-stage screenshots and the full-journey recording.)
- [x] **Minimum macOS version:** pinned to macOS 14.0 — `minimumSystemVersion: 14.0.0` in `application/electron-builder.yml` (#1217). Basis: Electron 37 supports the last three macOS majors (15/14/13); the only acceptance machine runs 14.8.9; macOS 13 has fallen outside that window with no test coverage and no Gatekeeper data.

> **The startup timing guard: per-component hang ceilings** (`application/scripts/perf-budget.json`, first-session table; the warm table keeps the same ceilings with shorter baselines and no unpack).
>
> What the three numbers mean, to avoid misreading:
> - **Hang ceiling (hard red line):** a component still short of its ready/healthy event past this value — or a missing event pair — is judged a hang: the gate exits 1, CI goes red. It is a loose tripwire, **NOT an expected duration**.
> - **Measured baseline (expected reference):** what the signed build actually takes on a healthy launch.
> - **Regression line (soft):** baseline × 1.4 — warn first, hard-fail on the second consecutive strike. Gradual drift trips here long before the ceiling.
>
> | Component (event pair) | Hang ceiling | Measured baseline (expected reference) | How the ceiling was derived |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | shell-boot (module-load → stack-spawned) | 30s | 6.2s | Loosened from measurement: unpack is ~1GB I/O-bound, 20s+ on slow disks; re-reviewed 20s → 30s |
> | unpack (first sessions only) | 30s | 2.0s | ~1GB I/O-bound extract, 20s+ on slow disks; same 30s floor as shell-boot |
> | runner-ready | 30s | 0.2–0.4s | Sub-second op; the 30s is a stall floor (GC/disk contention), not a multiplier |
> | memory-graph-ready | 45s | 0.6–2.9s | Healthy range already spans ~5× (cold imports); 45s covers the worst healthy case |
> | evolve-ready | 45s | 0.8–2.9s | Same: healthy range spans ~4×; 45s covers the worst healthy case |
> | api-ready (api-spawn → HEALTH-200, full-stack marker) | 60s | 3.2–3.6s | Cold-runner dependency imports can take tens of seconds; 60s covers the worst healthy case |
> | jw-ready (spawn-jw-app → IS-UP) | 120s | 4.8s (warm) / 7.9s (first) | Loosened: a from-scratch reinstall can take minutes |
> | agent-ready | 180s | 8.2–18.8s | **Pinned to the runtime constant `AGENT_READY_TIMEOUT_MS`** (= jw 120s + 60s watch/adapter margin; the gate and the runtime blow together, a unit test reads the source to keep them from drifting) |
> | shell-ui (AGENT-READY → loadUi-loadURL) | 15s | 0.1–0.2s | Sub-second UI load; 15s is the minimum floor against GC/Spotlight stalls (event pair corrected in review) |
> | warmup-done (AGENT-READY → [warmup] 200) | 60s | 0.4–1.3s | **Pinned to `FIRST_CHAT_WARMUP_TIMEOUT_MS`**; cold full-catalog measured ~48s, 60s just covers it (only 25% headroom — raise together if the catalog grows) |
>
> Derivation (why so wide): the ceiling only waits for events that never arrive — width changes how soon a hang is reported, not whether it is, and gradual drift trips the regression line (baseline × 1.4) first. The big multipliers come from the reference frames differing: the baseline column is a healthy dev machine's median, while the ceiling is sized for the **worst healthy case** (slow disk / loaded runner / cold caches / fresh install — warmup-done's 60s covers the measured 48s cold-catalog path, not the 1.3s warm path; jw-ready's 120s covers a from-scratch reinstall; agent-ready's 180s mirrors the runtime constant `AGENT_READY_TIMEOUT_MS`; sub-second components get a ~15s floor against transient stalls). Worst-case serial chain 320s < the 600s cold-start backstop.

## 🚀 背景说明

#400 确定了 Windows 和 macOS 双平台桌面交付设计，Windows 侧已经通过 #639、#643 和 #666 落地。本需求补齐 macOS 侧能力，让科研用户无需通过终端运行源码，也能完成 ScienceDiscovery 的安装、配置、任务执行和更新。

**当前状态（2026-11-17）：** PR #1156 已合入 `main`，合并提交为 `5058334f09a7b28c7c56dbbdb199b2adf13adf74`。原功能分支的 47 个提交在合并时压缩为一个提交，合并后的代码树与评审头 `43d54632` 逐字节一致。实现和代码评审已经完成；本 Issue 继续跟踪下方尚未完成的发布验收项。

关联：#400（交付总设计）、#666（Windows 桌面壳）、#34（桌面窗口起点）。

### 需求范围

- 让共用 Electron 壳适配 macOS 菜单、窗口与退出行为、数据和日志目录、系统代理及进程组生命周期。
- 由主进程在启动时检查 Seatbelt，沙箱健康显示于设置的状态行。*（#1336 于 2026-11-26 更新：探测失败不再阻断启动——中英文独立错误页已退役，设置 › 连接 › 沙箱网络的状态行是唯一展示面。）*
- 提供可复现的 macOS 载荷组装、DMG/ZIP 出包、Developer ID 签名、公证和 staple。
- 首次安装使用 DMG，后续更新使用公证 ZIP 和 `latest-mac.yml`，更新过程可见且只提示、不静默。
- 提供应用内数据清理，以及独立的离线卸载／重置脚本。
- 在 `win_desktop/` 更名为 `application/` 后，保持 Windows 行为、打包链和 CI 兼容。

### 目标使用流程

1. 下载签名 DMG。
2. 将 ScienceDiscovery 拖入 Applications。
3. 首次启动时选择数据目录。
4. 由桌面壳在后台执行 Seatbelt 和运行时启动检查；沙箱健康状态显示在设置的状态行。*（#1336 更新：探测失败时继续无沙箱启动，独立错误页已退役。）*
5. 配置模型并运行本地科研任务。
6. 后续通过可见的公证 ZIP／OTA 流程完成更新。

## 设计思路

### 技术架构

继续复用 JiuwenSwarm 的 Agent 底座。本需求负责接入科研服务并完成 macOS 桌面产品化，不再另建一套 Agent 能力。

```text
Electron 桌面壳
窗口、菜单、首启向导与进程管理
        ↓
科研服务
API、任务执行与运行时适配
        ↓
JiuwenSwarm
复用既有 Skills、Tools 与 Agent 能力
```

Seatbelt 在执行前先自检，沙箱健康状态显示于设置的状态行；数据和日志写入签名 `.app` 之外，保证应用包保持只读。*（#1336 更新：探测失败不再阻断启动，继续无沙箱运行。）*

### 运行时入口与出包入口

`application/` 是双平台共用的一套桌面壳，不是两套应用。`main.ts` 是公共 Electron 运行时入口，`platform/index.ts` 根据 `process.platform` 分发平台决策。

```text
application/src/main.ts
        ↓
platform/index.ts
        ├── win32.ts    Windows 路径、venv、托盘与窗口行为
        └── darwin.ts   macOS 路径、venv、Dock 与菜单行为
```

运行时入口和出包入口不是一回事：

| 平台 | 运行时入口 | 出包入口 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | `application/src/main.ts` → `platform/index.ts` → `platform/win32.ts` | `scripts/package-sd-windows.sh`，载荷默认按 `win32-x64` 组装 |
| macOS | `application/src/main.ts` → `platform/index.ts` → `platform/darwin.ts` | `application/scripts/build-mac.sh`；干净机器先执行 `build-mac-from-scratch.sh`，载荷按 `darwin-arm64` 组装 |

### 关键决策与约束

| 决策点 | 当前实现 | 原因 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 平台门面 | `application/src/platform/` 放置公共类型、win32、darwin 和统一分发入口 | 保持一套应用，隔离平台差异并便于单测 |
| 沙箱 | 默认 Seatbelt 沙箱；#1336 新增安装级直连执行 opt-in（默认关闭），探测失败时继续无沙箱启动并在状态行显示 | 默认安装保持沙箱；无沙箱运行是显式、有文档的选择而非静默降级 |
| 签名包完整性 | 写入改道到 `.app` 外；bootstrap 使用拷贝模式；`PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE` 传递到 MCP sidecar | 签名、公证后的应用包必须保持只读 |
| venv 搬迁 | 把构建机绝对路径符号链接改为指向包内 Python 的相对链接 | 符合 POSIX venv 结构，保证载荷可以迁移 |
| 桌面运行时 | v1 使用构建机上由 uv 安装的 Python，与 Windows 链一致；`scripts/binary-release/runtimes.json` 的 darwin 条目用于版本审计和未来可能的单文件版本，桌面组装暂不消费 | 让交付说明与 DMG/ZIP 的实际载荷一致 |
| 签名模式 | 默认 ad-hoc 冒烟；显式设置 `SD_MAC_SIGN=1` 才使用 Developer ID、公证和 staple | 避免冒烟构建误用正式凭证 |
| 更新 | 公证 ZIP＋`latest-mac.yml`，只提示，重启前停稳后端 | electron-updater 使用 ZIP，DMG 只负责首次安装 |
| 架构 | v1 仅支持 arm64 | Intel/x64 等有明确需求后再安排 |
| CI 边界 | Windows 桌面包分发由 CI 看护；macOS 出包和真机验收目前依靠本地证据 | 明确当前验证边界 |

### 平台行为差异

| 方面 | Windows | macOS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 安装 | NSIS / `setup.exe` | DMG 拖拽安装，公证 ZIP 用于更新 |
| 运行时结构 | `Scripts/`、`python.exe`、DLL | `bin/`、`python`、符号链接 |
| 执行安全 | 既有 Provider 路径 | 默认 Seatbelt；显式直连执行 opt-in（#1336） |
| 系统代理 | 注册表 | `scutil --proxy` |
| 卸载 | 卸载器＋可选深度清理 | 废纸篓＋应用内清理＋离线卸载／重置脚本 |

双平台共用 Electron 壳、Node 服务、Python 运行时和 JiuwenSwarm。

### 卸载与重置行为

帮助菜单提供应用内卸载和数据清理。`application/scripts/uninstall-mac.command` 提供四种离线模式：完全卸载、只卸载应用、数据重置和仅查看路径。脚本会备份指定的关键数据，将删除内容移入废纸篓，并检查后端残留进程。该脚本作为 Release 独立资产分发，不放进 DMG/ZIP。

### 界面与失败状态

打包后的桌面流程不展示 SPA `SetupWizard` 中的自检步骤。主进程在后台探测 Seatbelt（每会话一次）：探测结果——成功或失败——统一显示为设置 › 连接 › 沙箱网络的状态行。失败不再阻断初始化；中英文独立错误页随之退役（owner 决策见 #1336，2026-11-26）。

SPA 自检组件仍由组件测试看护，但其自检中、自检通过和组件内失败状态不属于打包桌面版的真实使用流程，因此不再作为产品截图展示。

**沙箱健康状态行（设置 › 连接 › 沙箱网络）**

Seatbelt 独立错误页（`seatbelt-error.html`）及其启动阻断门禁已于 #1336（2026-11-26）退役：探测失败不再替换窗口——应用继续无沙箱启动，状态行显示失败详情与可操作诊断；opt-in 直连执行档保持每次运行确认武装。

### 本期非目标

- 不迁移 Keychain/safeStorage，继续使用 AES-256-GCM＋`0600` 文件密钥方案。
- 不同时发布 Intel/x64 版本。
- 不增加 `.pkg` 安装器。
- 不另建 Agent 框架，也不重复实现 JiuwenSwarm 已有能力。
- 官网 `/install` 的 Mac 卡片和遥测改动不在本仓范围内。

## 涉及的公开接口

后端公开 API 没有变化。壳层通过 preload 增加 `sdShell.platform`，让前端读取主进程的真实平台值，而不是通过 UA 猜测。平台门面属于壳内部实现，后端起栈契约保持不变。

| 模块 | 影响及需要补充的验证 |
| --- | --- |
| `application/scripts/assemble-backend.mjs`、`application/scripts/lib/assemble-platform.mjs` | 增加按平台组装载荷的能力，默认仍走 Windows 方言；需要验证双平台载荷布局和必需文件。 |

> **版本间提升（v0.3.0 → v0.4.0，Windows）** —— 同一台联想 Windows 测试机。六项指标全面提升：
>
> | 指标 | v0.3.0 | v0.4.0 | 提升 |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | 安装包大小 | 791 MB | 587 MB | **缩小 204 MB（25.8%）** |
> | 首次安装 | 2min | 1min30s | 快 30s（25.0%） |
> | 首次初始化 | 18s | 11.4s | 快 6.6s（36.7%） |
> | 后续热启动 | 17s | 10.5s | 快 6.5s（38.2%） |

> | 卸载 | 30s | 25.4s | 快 4.6s（15.3%） |

### 测试矩阵

| 测试维度 | 需要守住的结果 | 验证方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 桌面壳功能 | 启动、停止、更新、卸载和双平台分支行为正常 | `pnpm --dir application test` |
| 编译与构建 | 提前发现类型、语法和壳构建问题 | `pnpm --dir application typecheck`、`pnpm --dir application build` |
| 平台隔离 | 公共分发正常，修改一端不影响另一端 | `application/src/platform/index.ts`、`win32.ts`／`darwin.ts` 分支测试和 `shell-platform.ts` 兼容测试 |
| 沙箱安全 | Seatbelt 是否存在、能否执行，以及启动失败、信号、退出码、超时和失败判定行为 | `sandbox-probe.ts` 真实探针，配合 `sandbox-probe.test.ts` 决策与异常测试。*（#1336 更新：探测结果供设置状态行使用，其上的 fail-closed 门禁已退役。）* |
| 界面与诊断 | 模型配置衔接、中英文文案和沙箱健康状态行诊断正确；打包流程不得展示 SPA 自检步骤 | `apps/desktop/tests/app-model-setup-render.test.ts`（打包衔接守卫：场景 × zh/en，注入 `sdShell: { wizardIntroDone: true }`）、`setup-wizard.test.tsx`（非打包组件状态）和组件渲染检查 |
| 安装包运行时完整性 | Python、依赖、符号链接、补丁和字节码完整 | `build-mac.sh`、`pyc-budget.test.ts`：A1 导入冒烟、A1b 运行时探针、A2 必需文件、A6 字节码，以及路径、符号链接和补丁链门禁 |
| 出包可复现性 | 全新 Mac／克隆不依赖未记录的本机状态也能出包 | 执行 `build-mac-from-scratch.sh`，再执行 `build-mac.sh` 本机门禁 |
| Apple 分发检查 | 应用和 DMG 的签名、公证、staple 与 Gatekeeper 评估通过 | 对两类产物执行 `codesign`、`notarytool`、`stapler` 和 `spctl` |
| 启动性能看护 | 健康启动不悄悄退化成挂死：每个组件都在报错上限内到达 ready/healthy 事件 | `perf-gate.mjs` 两层看护接入 CI（`macos-desktop` job，`--hang-only`）：经 `perf-smoke-mac.sh` 真实启动打包后的 `.app`，用 `perf-budget.json` 报错上限（H1-H9）判定首启 `shell.log`；实测日志以 `perf-smoke-shell-log-<sha>` artifact 上传——经 #1374 落地 |

使用模拟进程启动的单测负责验证决策逻辑，组件渲染负责验证界面状态，本机出包负责验证构建链；任何一项都不能单独替代剩余的真机发布验收。

启动性能看护在上述矩阵之后加入：它是针对「静默挂死」类的机器检查层，判定的正是真机发布验收所读的同一份日志。

## 验收标准

### 工程检查

- [x] 合并实现的 `pnpm --dir application test` 已通过。
- [x] 合并实现的 `pnpm --dir application typecheck` 已通过。
- [x] 本地 macOS 出包门禁和签名、公证链已实际执行。
- [x] 从零出包流程已通过 clean-room 复验。

### 发布验收

- [ ] **干净 macOS 环境验收**：下载 DMG → 拖入 Applications → 完成向导 → 跑通一个小任务；没有意外的 Gatekeeper 拦截，`spctl` 对 `.app` 和 DMG 均放行。
- [ ] **发布包沙箱健康可见性**：Seatbelt 失败时应用继续无沙箱启动，设置 › 连接 › 沙箱网络的状态行如实显示失败并提供可操作诊断；直连执行保持显式 opt-in。*（#1336 于 2026-11-26 改写：原「失败即阻断、不能进入主界面」的 fail-closed 红线随独立错误页一同退役。）*
- [ ] **签名包保持只读**：首启和二启都不写入 `.app`，并用 `codesign --verify --deep --strict` 复验封条。
- [ ] **退出语义**：Cmd+Q 排空并停止完整后端栈，包括独立进程组中的 JiuwenSwarm；不留孤儿进程，端口全部释放。
- [x] **Windows 回归**：`application/` 改名和载荷门禁调整后，安装、升级、卸载仍然正常。（证据：上方 Windows 实测数据表——setup.exe 587 MB、安装 1min30s、首次初始化 11.4s、热启动 10.5s、首对话 10.6s、卸载 25.4s——含各阶段截图与全流程录屏。）
- [x] **最低 macOS 版本**：已定为 macOS 14.0——`application/electron-builder.yml` 写入 `minimumSystemVersion: 14.0.0`（#1217）。依据：Electron 37 官方支持最近三个 macOS 大版本（15/14/13）；唯一验收机为 14.8.9；macOS 13 已出支持窗，无任何测试与 Gatekeeper 数据。
- [ ] **发布 CI 策略**：明确 v1 是否接受人工真机证据作为发布门禁，还是必须增加 macOS CI 任务。*更新：macOS CI 耗时看护已经 #1374 落地（`macos-desktop` job 冒烟启动打包 `.app` 并以 `--hang-only` 判定首启 `shell.log`，上传实测日志）——人工真机证据仍为基线来源，门禁在每个 PR/push 上覆盖静默挂死类风险。等 owner 对此记录签字确认。*

适用的工程检查和出包检查必须通过以下命令：

```bash
pnpm --dir application test
pnpm --dir application typecheck
pnpm --dir application build
bash application/scripts/build-mac.sh
spctl -a -vv -t open --context context:primary-signature <dmg>
```

## 补充信息

- 合并提交 `5058334` 记录 application 测试 **345/345**（macOS 上完整执行 `pnpm --dir application test`）。上游合入的导出相关测试分布在三个文件：`export-history.test.ts`（7 项）、`export-state.test.ts`（4 项）与 `export-tokens.test.ts`（5 项）。`apps/desktop` **30 项通过**为 `pnpm --dir apps/desktop test` 的全量结果（`tests/*.test.ts(x)`）。类型检查通过；Windows 分发门禁的 CI 契约检查通过。
- v0.4.0 冒烟 DMG 为 **578 MB**；从零出包流程已完成三次递进的 clean-room 复验。
- 签名、公证链已经实测通过。v1 凭证持有人与发布执行人（F1）：Developer ID Application 证书属 **Haowen Zhong**（Apple Developer 团队 **UGV44NUA6W**）；公证所用 App Store Connect 密钥与 `sd-notary` 钥匙串档案同由其保管，正式 macOS 发布亦由其执行。
- 官网 `/install` 和遥测工作需要在本仓之外单独跟踪。
- Intel/x64 分发继续后置。
- **启动性能看护（已合并，#1374 → `9c74af8b`）。** shell/start-stack/jiuwenswarm 打进 `shell.log` 的毫秒级打点现在由两层门禁判定：绝对 **hang 层**（报错上限 H1-H9 落在 `application/scripts/perf-budget.json`；缺失事件对即挂死信号；agent-ready 上限与运行时常量 `AGENT_READY_TIMEOUT_MS` 对齐，门禁与运行时同时引爆）+ 机器本地 **regression 层**（基线 × 1.4，warn-first、二振出局——只在有基线的机器上判定，因此 CI 以 `--hang-only` 运行）。`macos-desktop` CI job 真实启动打包后的 `.app`（`perf-smoke-mac.sh`：向导状态备份/恢复、轮转安全的日志增量锁定、信号陷阱），以 `--hang-only` 判定首启日志并上传实测日志（`perf-smoke-shell-log-<sha>`，14 天）作证据。合并前已在真实 macOS runner 端到端实证（fork Package@macos run 45541198600：ok 10 / hang 0 / exit 0，agent-ready 实测 20.9s，远低于 180s 上限）。解析器/判定层/门禁/冒烟均为纯新增，不改任何运行时行为。P2（向导/reuse 路径打点）与 P3-2（发布跑基线采集）留作后续。

> **启动性能看护：组件报错上限表**（`application/scripts/perf-budget.json` 首启档；热启档上限同值、基线更短、无 unpack）。
>
> 三层数值语义，防误读：
> - **报错上限（硬红线）**：组件超过该值仍未到达 ready/healthy 事件、或事件对缺失 → 判「挂死」→ 门禁 exit 1 → CI 红。它是宽松探测线，**不是预期值**。
> - **实测基线（预期参考）**：签名包健康启动的实际耗时——预期量级。
> - **回归警戒线（软线）**：基线 × 1.4；超先警告，连续第二次硬失败。渐进退化在此提前报警，不用等到碰上限。
>
> | 组件（事件对） | 报错上限 | 实测基线（预期参考） | 上限如何而来 |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | shell-boot（module-load → stack-spawned） | 30s | 6.2s | 实测放宽：unpack 为 ~1GB I/O 主导，慢盘机器可 20s+，复审从 20s 放宽到 30s |
> | unpack（仅首启档） | 30s | 2.0s | ~1GB 解压 I/O 主导，慢盘可 20s+，与 shell-boot 同 30s 地板 |
> | runner-ready | 30s | 0.2~0.4s | 亚秒操作；上限是防瞬时卡顿（GC/磁盘争用）的地板值，非按倍数定 |
> | memory-graph-ready | 45s | 0.6~2.9s | 健康范围近 5 倍（冷依赖导入）；45s 罩最坏健康场景，防卡顿地板 |
> | evolve-ready | 45s | 0.8~2.9s | 同上：健康范围已达 4 倍，45s 罩最坏健康场景 |
> | api-ready（api-spawn → HEALTH-200，全栈标志） | 60s | 3.2~3.6s | 冷 runner 依赖导入可达几十秒，60s 罩最坏健康场景 |
> | jw-ready（spawn-jw-app → IS-UP） | 120s | 4.8s（热）/ 7.9s（首） | 实测放宽：从零重装可到分钟级 |
> | agent-ready | 180s | 8.2~18.8s | **对齐运行时常量 `AGENT_READY_TIMEOUT_MS`**（= jw 120s + watch 轮询/adapter 启动 60s 余量；门禁与运行时同时引爆，单测读源码钉死防漂移） |
> | shell-ui（AGENT-READY → loadUi-loadURL） | 15s | 0.1~0.2s | 亚秒 UI 加载；15s 是防 GC/Spotlight 瞬时卡顿的最低地板（事件对曾误配，复审已修正） |
> | warmup-done（AGENT-READY → [warmup] 200） | 60s | 0.4~1.3s | **对齐 `FIRST_CHAT_WARMUP_TIMEOUT_MS`**；冷态全量 catalog 实测 ~48s，60s 恰好罩住（余量仅 25%，catalog 膨胀需同步上调） |
>
> 推导口径（为何这么宽）：上限只等「永不到来」的事件——宽窄只影响报警早晚、不影响是否报警，渐进变慢由回归警戒线（基线 × 1.4）先抓。倍数看着大是因为参照系不同：基线列是开发机健康启动的中位数，上限对着的是**最坏健康场景**（慢磁盘/高负载 runner/冷缓存/从零安装——warmup-done 60s 罩的是冷态 catalog 实测 48s 而非热态 1.3s，jw-ready 120s 罩从零重装，agent-ready 180s = 运行时常量 `AGENT_READY_TIMEOUT_MS` 的镜像，亚秒组件另有 ~15s 起的防瞬时卡顿误报地板）。串行最坏 320s < 冷启兜底 600s。

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] The description below includes environment information and a minimal reproduction, so the issue can be reproduced without further questions.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Summary**

When the selected model has no saved API key, the run fails with the generic `semantic-error` card. In a Chinese UI the main screen only says "运行中遇到了意外问题，任务未能完成。建议重试", and the actual cause — an English sentence — appears only after expanding "技术详情":

```
semantic-error
The selected model does not have a saved API token
```

This is a user-fixable configuration problem presented as an unexplained crash: the message is not readable in the UI language, and it is one click away from the place where the user would act.

**Steps to reproduce**

1. Open the desktop client (front end on 5174, API on 4410), locale `zh-CN`.
2. Settings › Models › add a custom model whose credential is left empty (any base URL, `tokenOptional` not effective for runs).
3. Select that model in the composer and send any message.
   - Observed: a failure card titled "运行异常"; expanding "技术详情" reveals `semantic-error` plus the English sentence above.
   - Expected: a readable failure that names the cause and the next step, for example "模型还没有配置 API Key / 到 设置 › 模型 补上后再试".

Reproduced 3 out of 3 times.

**Why it happens**

- The API raises a plain 400 at `services/api/src/runs/index.ts:842`:
  `throw new ApiStatusError(400, "The selected model does not have a saved API token");`
- `services/api/src/run-failure.ts:28` `classifyRunFailure()` matches only tool-call, timeout, auth-status, rate-limit, 5xx and transport wording. This 400 matches nothing and falls through to the catch-all `semantic-error`.
- `packages/schema/src/session.ts:578` `RunFailureCode` therefore has no code that describes this case.
- The desktop already has localized copy per code (`apps/desktop/src/text/zh.ts:1633`, `en.ts:1582`), but with no code to look up it can only render the catch-all text. `apps/desktop/src/views/RunFailureCard.tsx:35-36` then prints the raw code and raw message inside the details block.

**Proposed fix (agreed approach)**

Give this failure its own code and its own copy, using the mechanism that already exists:

1. `packages/schema/src/session.ts` — add `model-credential-missing` to `RunFailureCode`.
2. `services/api/src/runs/index.ts:842` — raise a typed error that carries the code (do not depend on prose matching), and make `classifyRunFailure()` return it so the `run.failed` event carries `errorCode: "model-credential-missing"`.
3. `apps/desktop/src/text/zh.ts` and `en.ts` — add entries to `runFailure.titles` and the per-code body:
   - zh title: 模型还没有配置 API Key
   - zh body: 这个模型在设置里没有保存 API Key，运行无法开始。到 设置 › 模型 补上后重试。
   - en title: Model has no API key
   - en body: This model has no saved API key, so the run cannot start. Add one in Settings › Models and try again.
4. `apps/desktop/src/views/RunFailureCard.tsx` — for this code, render one localized sentence above the `<pre>` in "技术详情", keeping the provider text verbatim below it for diagnostics.
5. Tests: extend `services/api/src/run-failure.test.ts` (classification) and `apps/desktop/tests/run-failure.test.ts` (title/body lookup).

**Acceptance criteria**

- With a model that has no saved key, the failure card title and body are localized and name the missing key plus the settings path.
- The raw provider message still appears in "技术详情" (diagnostics are not lost).
- A regression test covers the new code on both the API classifier and the desktop copy lookup.

closed_recent.author: yuanzhou75
closed_recent.body:
## What happens

A path parameter that is not a valid id answers `500` when it contains a malformed percent-escape or a NUL byte. Two layers do it, with two different bodies, and neither names the input:

**A. The Python adapter answers 500 before the request is proxied** — a NUL (`%00`) in any path parameter:

```
GET /api/models/id-%00
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
server: uvicorn
content-type: text/plain; charset=utf-8

Internal Server Error
```

A normal unknown id answers the contract-correct `404`, so the status is specific to the malformed input:

```
GET /api/models/id-plain      → 404 {"error":"Not found"}
GET /api/models/id-%00        → 500 Internal Server Error   (plain text, from uvicorn)
```

The same `500` reproduces on these routes with `id-%00` (all against `127.0.0.1:4310`, no state changed — read-only GETs):

`/api/models/:id`, `/api/projects/:id/settings`, `/api/projects/:id/sessions`, `/api/skills/:id`, `/api/specialists/:id`, `/api/environments/:id`, `/api/runners/:id`, `/api/remote-hosts/:id`, `/api/proxy/servers/:id`, `/api/mcp/sources/:id`, `/api/skill-libraries/:id`, `/api/sessions/:id`, `/api/sessions/:id/artifacts`.

**B. The Node API answers 500 when a path segment cannot be decoded** — an invalid percent-escape (`%%`):

```
GET /api/skills/id-%%
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"error":"Internal server error"}
```

(`server: uvicorn` because the adapter proxies the Node answer back; the JSON shape and the log line below are the Node control API's, and the same route's `404` has the same shape.)

```
GET /api/skills/id-plain      → 404 {"error":"Skill not found: id-plain"}
GET /api/skills/id-%%         → 500 {"error":"Internal server error"}
```

Its log entry names the real cause:

```
ERROR [api] event=unclassified_request_error errorMessage="URI malformed" method=GET path="/api/skills/id-%%" status=500
```

Reproduced on `/api/skills/:id`, `/api/runners/:id`, `/api/skill-libraries/:id`.

## What is expected

`400` with a message naming the parameter (the same shape the rest of the API uses for a client mistake), or `404` when the input is merely unknown. A local client mistake must not answer `500`, and it must not be classified as an unclassified server error in the log.

## Where it comes from

**A. `services/adapter/src/sciencediscovery_adapter/proxy.py:84-87`** builds the upstream URL outside the `try` that starts at line 89:

```python
upstream_url = (
    httpx.URL(path=request.url.path, query=request.url.query.encode())
    if request.url.query else httpx.URL(path=request.url.path)
)
try:
    ...
except httpx.HTTPError as error:
    ... return JSONResponse({"error": "legacy_unavailable", ...}, status_code=502)
```

With httpx 0.28.1 (the version the installed adapter's own interpreter reports),

```
httpx.InvalidURL: Invalid non-printable ASCII character in URL path component, '\x00' at position 15.
```

`InvalidURL` is **not** a subclass of `httpx.HTTPError` (`InvalidURL → Exception`), so moving the construction inside that `try` would still not catch it: the path needs its own validation (reject `%00`/non-printable with 400) and its own error mapping.

**B. `services/api/src/http/index.ts`** decodes path segments inline, without a guard, in 63 places, e.g.:

```ts
const skillId = decodeURIComponent(skillMatch[1]!);
```

`decodeURIComponent("%%")` throws `URIError: URI malformed`, which reaches the generic handler and becomes `500`.

## Impact

- API contract: a client mistake is reported as a server fault, so the desktop/web client shows its generic failure surface instead of the actual reason.
- Log noise: every such request writes `unclassified_request_error`, which is the event the team uses to find real server faults.
- No data disclosure in either case: the bodies are the generic `Internal Server Error` / `{"error":"Internal server error"}`, with no stack trace or internal path.

## Environment

- Windows 11, installed desktop build **ScienceDiscovery 0.4.0** (local stack on `127.0.0.1:4310`, adapter `python -m sciencediscovery_adapter.server` under uvicorn, plus the Node control API behind it).
- `/api/health` detail: `milestone M4`, runner `9598fa94`, `sandbox: none`.
- Probes were read-only `GET`s with the local bearer token; no project, session or settings were created, changed or deleted.
- Code check against `main` `13f32dd5dd417283a397363496f0cae4f67326cb`: both patterns above are still present (`proxy.py:84-87` outside the `try`, and 63 inline `decodeURIComponent` sites in `http/index.ts`). The reproduction itself was run against the installed 0.4.0 build.

## Version Information

- Desktop: 0.4.0 (installed build, Windows x64)
- `main` at the time of the report: `13f32dd5dd417283a397363496f0cae4f67326cb`

closed_recent.author: yuanzhou75
closed_recent.body:
## 🚀 Background Description

The desktop client has no way to find a Session except scrolling the sidebar. The server already serves a workbench search and the web client already consumes it, so this is a client gap rather than a new capability.

Verified on `main` `9f641cf1`:

| Piece | State |
| --- | --- |
| Search endpoint | `GET /api/search?q=&limit=&offset=` (`services/api/src/http/index.ts:1818-1824`) → `searchWorkbench` (`services/api/src/workbench/index.ts:29-93`) |
| What it matches | project **names**; Session **titles** (plus project name and Session id); artifact **names/titles** (plus their Session title and project). It does **not** look inside messages |
| Result shape | `WorkbenchSearchResult` with `kind: "project" \| "session" \| "artifact"`, project/session context, `archived` flag for Sessions, and `hasMore`/`total` paging |
| Web client | a palette in the composer (`apps/web/src/composer/WorkbenchNavigation.tsx:103` debounce, `:164` client-side filtering, `@`/`#` triggers) |
| Desktop client | **nothing**: no `/api/search` call anywhere in `apps/desktop/src`, no search field, no result list |

Two secondary gaps in the desktop list itself:

- The sidebar only ever asks for `state="active"` (`apps/desktop/src/api/sessions.ts:71-78` and its only caller `app/use-workspace.ts:763`), so nothing but the default view exists. The archive-state filter is tracked in `#1250`; this issue should not duplicate it.
- There is no filter other than "which project am I in": no by-kind, no by-time, no "has artifacts / is running".

Message-content search is a real user need, but `searchWorkbench` only reads titles today; adding it means an index and belongs to a follow-up once this UI exists.

## Design Ideas

1. **A search field at the top of the session sidebar** (and the same one reachable from the command palette if the desktop gains one): debounce ~250 ms like the web client, call `GET /api/search`, and render results grouped by kind — 项目 / 会话 / 产物 — with the project context (no `已归档` marker: archived Sessions never appear in the results — withdrawn 2026-11-27 by the repository owner, [this comment](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/issues/1251#issuecomment-7208777074)).
2. **Keyboard first**: `Ctrl/Cmd+K` opens it, arrow keys move, `Enter` opens the result (Session → open, project → switch, artifact → open its dialog). Escape closes and restores the previous list.
3. ~~**Filters for the session list**, applied client-side over the returned page while the result set is small: 仅当前项目 / 全部项目, 仅运行中, 有产物的会话, and a time window (今天 / 最近 7 天 / 全部).~~ **Withdrawn 2026-11-26 (22:18 CST) by the repository owner** — no session-list narrowing ships with this issue; see *Withdrawn scope* under Acceptance Criteria. State (活动/已归档/全部) stays with `#1250`.
4. **Be honest about the search scope**: label the field so it does not promise message search ("搜索会话、项目、产物"), and put the content-search follow-up in the issue rather than faking it.
5. **Empty and error states**: a query with no results says so with the current scope; an API failure shows the reason and a retry instead of an empty list.

`GET /api/search` can gain additive `kind`/`projectId` params later; this issue works without them.

## Involved Public APIs

Consumed only, no changes required:

- `GET /api/search?q=&limit=&offset=` → `WorkbenchSearchResponse` (`results[]`, `total`, `hasMore`)
- `GET /api/projects/:id/sessions?state=…` for the list itself

If scoped search parameters are added later, that is a separate additive change.

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules

| Module | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `apps/desktop/src/api/workbench.ts` (new) | `search(q, limit, offset)` client |
| `apps/desktop/src/views/Sidebar.tsx` | Search field, result list (the filter row is withdrawn — 2026-11-26, repository owner) |
| `apps/desktop/src/app/use-workspace.ts` | Query state, selection after a result opens, refresh behaviour |
| `apps/desktop/src/text/{zh,en}.ts`, styles | Copy and layout |
| `apps/web` | Reference only (its palette is the behavioural model) |
| `services/api`, `packages/*` | Untouched |

Related, non-overlapping: `#1250` (archive/restore filter and actions).

## Test Design and Test Plan

- **Component tests**: typing debounces and issues one request per settled query; results render grouped by kind with project context (the archived marker is withdrawn — archived Sessions are not searchable, 2026-11-27); keyboard navigation opens the right target; ~~filters narrow the session list and persist for the session~~; empty result and API failure states.
- **E2E on the desktop build with the real stack**: search a term that only a Session title contains, one that only an artifact name contains, and one that only a message body contains (the last must return nothing and say why); open a result with the keyboard. ~~Filter to 仅运行中 during a run and back~~ — no session-list narrowing ships (2026-11-26, repository owner).
- Commands: `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test`, `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop build`, `pnpm ci:l1`.
- Screenshots (empty field, results grouped by kind, no-result state) go in the PR body for the owner's approval; the owner has approved the set delivered with #1290.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A search field in the desktop sidebar queries `/api/search` with debounce and renders results grouped by 项目 / 会话 / 产物 with their context.
- [ ] ~~Archived Sessions in the results carry an 已归档 marker, and opening one lands in the read-only view.~~ — **Withdrawn 2026-11-27 by the repository owner**: archived Sessions and their artifacts are not searchable at all, so no hit ever carries the marker — [this comment](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/issues/1251#issuecomment-7208908315).
- [ ] `Ctrl/Cmd+K` focuses search, arrows move the selection, `Enter` opens it, Escape closes.
- [ ] ~~The session list can be narrowed by 仅当前项目 / 仅运行中 / 有产物 / 时间窗口, and the choice survives a reload.~~ — **Withdrawn 2026-11-26 (22:18 CST) by the repository owner.**
- [ ] No results and API failures are distinguishable, and both offer the next step.
- [ ] The field's copy does not imply message-content search; that gap is recorded as a follow-up in the issue.
- [ ] zh-CN and en copy; `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck|test|build` and `pnpm ci:l1` pass.
- [ ] The owner has seen the screenshots in the PR body.

### Withdrawn scope

**Criterion 4 — session-list narrowing (2026-11-26, 22:18 CST).** The **repository owner**
decided that this issue does not deliver session-list narrowing. 搜索 ships as a dialog opened
from the column's title row, and its 全部 / 项目 / 会话 / 产物 footer filters what a query
returns — not the list. Criterion 4, Design Idea 3, the narrowing lines in the test plan and the
filter row in the relevance table are withdrawn by that decision and marked so in place.

**Criterion 2 — the archived marker (2026-11-27).** The same owner decided on **2026-11-27 (CST)**
that archived Sessions and their artifacts do not appear in search results at all, so a hit never
needs an 已归档 marker. What stays: an imported read-only snapshot **is** searchable, and the line
this issue draws is archived versus live, not writable versus read-only. Criterion 2 is withdrawn
at the "archived hits are searchable and marked" layer; the decision, the card's wording and the
replacement rule are recorded in [this comment](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/issues/1251#issuecomment-7208908315) and, with its provenance, in
[this earlier one](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/issues/1251#issuecomment-7208777074).
What still stands, so that the whole criterion is accounted for: archived Sessions **and their
artifacts** stay out of the results; an imported read-only snapshot **is** searchable and opens
in the read-only view, so only the archived path into that view is gone; and `archived` is still
returned by `GET /api/search` on Session hits — the desktop client drops archived hits before it
builds the list, so the flag remains a fact about the API, not a requirement on this UI.

Every other criterion stands unchanged. The delivery is #1290, which closes this issue on merge.

## Additional Information

Verified on `main` `9f641cf1`: the endpoint and its matcher (`workbench/index.ts:39-83` — names/titles only, no message bodies), the web palette's debounce and client-side kinds, and the absence of any search client or UI in `apps/desktop/src`.

Out of scope here: message-content search (needs an index; follow-up), the archive-state filter (`#1250`), and any change to what `searchWorkbench` indexes.

closed_recent.author: HongyeZhou
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help. #1474 is the sibling report (a research left running with its credential revoked after a lost command answer); this one is the deletion path, which #1474 explicitly leaves out of scope and #1475 does not touch.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version: `main` at `973849ab` still revokes a Session's research grants only after the sidecar delete call succeeds.
- [x] The description below carries source locations. No live run was made on this host, as stated under Additional Information.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Summary.** Deleting a Session is what retires the LLM-proxy credentials of its researches, and that retirement runs *after* the evolve sidecar confirms the delete (or per-Session cleanup). When that call fails — sidecar down, busy, or answering non-2xx — the rejection is logged and dropped, the revoke loop never runs, and the Session's grants stay in the registry. The 5-second fallback sweep cannot recover them either: for a deleted Session it asks `get` with a Session that no longer exists, `invoke` throws `Session not found` before contacting the engine, and the sweep swallows every rejection. So those grants stay resolvable for the life of the process, and each one costs a futile read every 5 seconds until then.

**Current code path** (`main` `973849ab`):

1. `services/api/src/http/index.ts:3463` (bulk Session impact) and `:3819` (single Session delete) call `void ideaResearch.cleanup(...)` and only log a failure.
2. `services/api/src/idea-tree/research.ts` `cleanup()` awaits `POST /idea-tree/research/command {operation: "delete"}`, throws on `!response.ok`, and only then loops over `grants` revoking the ids whose `sessionId` matches. A failed call therefore throws before any grant is given back.
3. The fallback sweep in the same file (`RETIRE_SWEEP_MS = 5000`) walks `grants` and calls `command(sessionId, "get", …)` with `.catch(() => undefined)`.
4. `invoke()` resolves the Session first: `options.store.getSession(sessionId)`. For a deleted Session that is `undefined`, so it throws `Session not found` before the request is made — and the sweep discards exactly that error.

**Expected behaviour.** A deleted Session retires its grants regardless of whether the sidecar cleanup succeeded: either revoke them synchronously with the Session record's removal (the grants map is this process's own state and does not need the engine to answer), or make the sweep treat "the Session is gone" as terminal and retire the entry. Nothing else should have to know.

**Impact.** A credential that outlives the object it belongs to: `RunTokenRegistry.resolve()` keeps answering for a deleted Session's research, and the sweep re-reads once per 5 seconds per orphan for the rest of the process's life. Not a data-loss or crash path — a credential and resource leak.

**Minimal reproduction (source-level).** Delete a Session while the evolve sidecar is unreachable, so `cleanup()` throws at the `!response.ok`/fetch step; then bring the sidecar back and watch the sweep: every 5 seconds `get` is attempted with the deleted Session id, `getSession` returns `undefined`, `invoke` throws, `.catch(() => undefined)` discards it, and `grants` keeps the entry until `close()`.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

Source inspection only; no running stack on this host. Repository `openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery`, affected surfaces are the API's Session-deletion routes, the idea-research client's grant registry and the LLM proxy that resolves those grants.

### Additional Information

- Reported first in #1474's Additional Information and echoed in #1475's Scope section; filed separately so it is not lost when #1475 merges.
- The reverse ordering is deliberate on the engine side: the credential must outlive the last model call, so revoking before the engine has stopped would trade a leak for a dead run. The fix here is about the *deletion* signal, not about revoking earlier.
- Related: #1475 (lost command answer must not revoke a live research's credential), #1474.

### Version Information

- `main`: `973849abb0f25969142fb513dc001dcb161b5168` (2026-11-27)
- Lines cited were read at that commit.
closed_recent.title: [Bug]: deleting a Session leaves its research grants in the registry when the sidecar cleanup fails

closed_recent.author: yuanzhou75
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**What the user sees first:** one skill file with a broken frontmatter makes the API answer **HTTP 400 to every request**, including `GET /health`. The workbench becomes unusable (nothing loads), and any health probe — the desktop's readiness check, the E2E `requireRealStack` gate, a monitoring check — reports the service as broken, although the process is running and its data is intact.

**Measured.** A skill that is actually loaded (`skills/idea-tree-team/SKILL.md`, the file shipped in the repo) had an unquoted `description` containing `: `, which is invalid YAML. With that file in the tree:

```
$ curl -sS -m 3 -w '\nHTTP=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:4310/health
{"error":"SKILL.md frontmatter is invalid YAML: Nested mappings are not allowed in compact mappings at line 2, column 14:\n\ndescription: Use when the composer message starts with /idea-tree or /idea-tree-team, or the user explicitly asks for autonomous Idea Tree research: prepare supplied inputs for the research and explain its saved results.\n             ^\n"}
HTTP=400
```

- The same request **with** `Authorization: Bearer <token>` returns the identical body and `HTTP 400`.
- `HTTP 400`, not `503` and not a degraded payload: the failure is a refusal at the request entrance, before routing.
- The process had already logged `ScienceDiscovery listening on http://127.0.0.1:4310` and had served requests before the file was swapped in, so this is a **runtime, per-request** failure, not a startup crash.

**Negative control.** A newly added skill directory that is *not* loaded (a stray `skills/zz-bad-yaml-probe/SKILL.md` with the same kind of invalid YAML) did **not** break anything: `/health` kept answering `200`. So the trigger is "a skill the catalog actually loads", not "any YAML file under `skills/`".

**Expected.** A malformed skill file should be reported (logged, and once in the UI where skills are listed) and that **one** skill skipped; it must not take the whole API — and certainly not `/health` — down. `GET /health` should keep answering its normal payload, because a health probe must not depend on skill content.

**Reproduce**

1. Put the invalid frontmatter above into `skills/idea-tree-team/SKILL.md` (the description value unquoted, containing `: `).
2. Start the stack: `./scripts/start-stack.sh --mode local --no-node-build --no-jiuwenswarm`.
3. `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4310/health` → `HTTP 400` with the JSON error above.
4. Restore a valid file → `HTTP 200` with the normal health payload, no restart of anything else needed.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- WSL Ubuntu 24.04 on Windows 11 (Chinese locale), linux-amd64, Node v22.
- Checkout: `sciencediscovery`, working tree synced to `main` (2026-11-22); the malformed file came from a PR head under review (`667368d7`), reproduced on that head.
- Stack: `./scripts/start-stack.sh --mode local --no-node-build --no-jiuwenswarm`; API on `http://127.0.0.1:4310`, default data directory `.sciencediscovery-data`, real runner, bubblewrap 0.9.0.
- Reproduced twice: once incidentally while running a real E2E journey, once as this write-up's reproduction.
- Model endpoint is irrelevant to this defect (no model call is needed).

### Additional Information

- The error text is emitted by the skill-catalog load path; it names the offending file and the YAML line/column, so the loader already knows which file failed — the missing part is containing that failure to that one skill.
- Scope I verified directly: `GET /health`, authenticated and not. Because the refusal happens at the request entrance (the same body is returned for a route that must never read skills), I expect other routes are equally affected, but I did not probe them one by one — that part is inference, not measurement.
- Suggested acceptance: a malformed skill file is logged and skipped; `/health` still answers 200; the skills list shows that one skill as failed rather than the catalog being empty; and a test feeds the loader an invalid frontmatter and asserts the API still answers `/health`.
- This is a product defect and is independent of the PR that happened to contain the malformed file (that PR only edits prose in a skill description).

### Version Information

- Product code under test: repo `main` working tree synced 2026-11-22 (the checkout is synced by tarball, so its `.git` HEAD is stale; the working tree is what ran).
- Malformed file provenance: PR head `667368d7` (fixed later at `e4410b80`, which parses cleanly).
- No desktop build was involved: the defect reproduces over the HTTP API alone.
closed_recent.title: [Bug]: one skill file with invalid frontmatter makes every API route return 400, including /health

closed_recent.author: HongyeZhou
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Summary.** The Scientific-memory status does not check the thing the queries need. A memory-graph service that answers its unauthenticated health endpoint but rejects every query with `401` is reported as `运行正常` (`Running normally`), and every citation card then says only `暂时读不到科学记忆`.

**Steps to reproduce**

1. Run a memory-graph sidecar whose internal token differs from the API's `SCIENCE_AGENT_MEMORY_GRAPH_INTERNAL_TOKEN` (in a mixed local stack this happens by accident; I hit it on `127.0.0.1:17674`, a sidecar started by someone else).
2. Open `设置 › 科学记忆`.
3. Press a citation chip in any report.

**Observed**

```text
$ curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer wrong' \
    -d '{"node_types":["Evidence"]}' http://127.0.0.1:17675/query/by-node-type
401    ->   {"detail":"invalid internal token"}

Settings page:  运行正常
Citation card:  暂时读不到科学记忆 / 记忆服务没有响应。稍后再试一次。
```

The status surface reports health, the query path reports an authentication failure, and the user is told "the memory service did not answer" — which is false; it answered `401`.

**Expected.** The status row separates "service up but this process cannot authenticate" from "service down", and the citation card's `memory_graph_unreachable` reason distinguishes an auth rejection from a transport failure. `运行正常` must not be shown while every query is refused.

**Impact**

- A misconfigured token looks like a healthy installation; the only symptom is that citations stop opening, with copy that blames a timeout.
- Users retry, restart the sidecar and re-check health — none of which can help, because nothing points at credentials.
- It also hides this class of misconfiguration from support: the status page says there is nothing to fix.

**Suggested fix.** Probe the authenticated path (a cheap `by-node-type` with an empty type list) for the status row, and give the auth rejection its own reason/copy instead of folding it into `memory_graph_unreachable`.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- ScienceDiscovery desktop client + local stack on Linux (Ubuntu 22.04.5).
- API `127.0.0.1:4410`, memory-graph sidecar `127.0.0.1:17675` (and, when the mix-up happened, a foreign sidecar on `17674` with a different token).
- Observed 2026-11-22, re-confirmed 2026-11-24 on `9da58ad6` that `/api/health` reports liveness `ok` while an unauthenticated query returns `401 invalid internal token`.

### Additional Information

- Screenshot of the memory settings page showing `运行正常` is in the comment below; the `401` body is quoted above.

closed_recent.author: HongyeZhou
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] The description below includes environment information and a minimal reproduction, so the issue can be reproduced without further questions.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Summary**

In the desktop client the workspace panel's maximum width is computed as if the left task sidebar were still on screen, but opening the panel removes that sidebar (`App.tsx:1377`). The reserved width is subtracted from a window that no longer contains it, so the panel opens narrower than its own default and, at ordinary laptop widths, the splitter cannot move it at all.

**Steps to reproduce** (viewport 1500x950, `zh-CN`)

1. Open the desktop client and open any session that has artifacts (one generated `sales.csv` is enough).
2. Click the workspace panel control (`aria-label="工作区面板"`).
   - Observed: `.app-shell` becomes `sidebar-hidden panel-open` — the task sidebar is not rendered — and the panel opens at 628 px.
3. Drag the splitter to the left, or focus it and press `Shift+ArrowLeft` five times.
   - Expected: the panel widens, as it does on a wide window.
   - Observed: the panel stays at 628 px; not one pixel moves.
4. Widen the window to 1800 px and repeat step 3.
   - Observed: the panel goes 720 → 928 px and stops at 928, so the behaviour is a ceiling, not a broken splitter.

**Measured**

| viewport | panel on open | after 5x Shift+ArrowLeft | ceiling the code gives | ceiling if the hidden sidebar is not reserved |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1800x950 | 720 | 928 | 928 | 1100 (capped) |
| 1500x950 | 628 | 628 | 628 | 924 |
| 1440x950 | 568 | 568 | 568 | 864 |
| 1280x950 | 480 | 480 | 480 | 704 |

1500 px is an ordinary laptop width, and there the ceiling (628) is *below* `PANEL_DEFAULT_WIDTH` (720): `PANEL_DEFAULT_WIDTH` only applies from 1592 px up (`720 + 872`). The same happens at 1440 px (568) and 1280 px (480, the floor), which is why the splitter feels decorative rather than merely limited.

**Root cause pointer**

- `apps/desktop/src/app/panel-width.ts:81` — `clampPanelWidth` builds `ceiling = Math.min(PANEL_MAX_WIDTH, viewportWidth - PANEL_SIDEBAR_WIDTH - PANEL_MIN_CHAT_WIDTH)`, with `PANEL_SIDEBAR_WIDTH = 360` (line 44) and `PANEL_MIN_CHAT_WIDTH = 512` (line 47).
- `apps/desktop/src/App.tsx:1377` — `const taskSidebar = sidebarOpen && !panelOpen;`: while the panel is open the task sidebar is not rendered at all, so there is no sidebar column to reserve. The comment directly above it (`App.tsx:1371-1375`) states the same thing: the panel takes the sidebar's place rather than sharing the window with it.
- The constant does not match the layout either. The task column is 296 px (`apps/desktop/src/styles/design.css:184`, `--d-sidebar: 296px` in `styles/tokens.css:70`) and the rail is 64 px (`design.css:60-66`, `--d-rail`); the comment above `PANEL_SIDEBAR_WIDTH` still quotes an older grid, `256px minmax(0, 1fr) var(--panel-width)` from `styles/shell.css:26`, which `design.css` overrides because `styles/index.css` imports it last.
- `apps/desktop/tests/panel-width.test.ts:44-70` asserts the current arithmetic, so its expectations move with the fix.

**Suggested fix**

Reserve only the columns that are actually laid out. While the panel is open, that is the 64 px rail plus the 512 px conversation floor:

```ts
const ceiling = Math.min(
  PANEL_MAX_WIDTH,
  viewportWidth - PANEL_RAIL_WIDTH - (panelOpen ? 0 : PANEL_SIDEBAR_WIDTH) - PANEL_MIN_CHAT_WIDTH,
);
```

with `PANEL_SIDEBAR_WIDTH` corrected to 296. With that, 1500 px allows 924 px and 1800 px reaches the 1100 px cap.

If `clampPanelWidth` should stay a pure function of two numbers, the alternative is to pass the conversation column's real available width from `use-panel-width.ts:69` instead of `window.innerWidth`, reading `.app-shell`'s two fixed columns once per render.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Product: ScienceDiscovery desktop client (`apps/desktop`), run as the web dev surface: front end `http://127.0.0.1:5174`, API on `127.0.0.1:4410`, runner on `127.0.0.1:4411`.
- Host: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS, Node.js 22.23.2, pnpm 11.1.2.
- Browser: Playwright's Chromium build 1228 (headless), viewports 1800x950 / 1500x950 / 1440x950 / 1280x950, locale `zh-CN`.
- Reproduced by hand in the same build at all four widths, and by script on repeated runs.

### Additional Information

- Screenshots attached: the same session at 1800 and at 1500, before and after five `Shift+ArrowLeft` presses. The coloured box is the panel's measured edge, checked against the rendered border in the raw captures (x = 872 at 1500, x = 1080/872 at 1800 before/after).
- The width itself is remembered in `localStorage` (`PANEL_WIDTH_STORAGE_KEY`) and the clamp is applied to what is rendered only (`use-panel-width.ts:69`), so the stored width is not damaged — it is just never shown at these viewport widths.
- No console error is involved; this is a wrong input to one calculation.

### Version Information

- Repository: `openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery`, branch `main`
- Commit: `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-21)
- Desktop app package version: `0.0.0` (private workspace package)

![Q9-panel-width-en](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/146eeb08-ee9f-4aa4-9e03-0e654f8e2c2b)

closed_recent.body:

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Summary.** Two user-facing strings outside the translation table stay Chinese in the English UI: the fallback filename of an untitled session export (`科研会话_…_.sdresearch`) and the error raised when a package download keeps failing (`证据包下载失败，请重试。`). The default account name has the same problem.

**Steps to reproduce**

1. Switch the interface language to `English`.
2. Export a session that has no title (a fresh session, or one whose title the server left empty) — the native save dialog proposes `科研会话_20261125_2240.sdresearch`.
3. Or let a package download exhaust its retries — the toast reads `证据包下载失败，请重试。`.

**Observed** (`645dc7ba`)

```ts
// apps/desktop/src/views/ResearchPackage.tsx:27
const title = (detail.title ?? "").trim().replace(...).slice(0, 120) || "科研会话";
// :81
throw lastError instanceof Error ? lastError : new Error("证据包下载失败，请重试。");
// apps/desktop/src/auth/account.ts:33
export const DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_NAME = "华为账号用户";   // used at LoginPage.tsx:79/115/154
```

None of the three has an entry in `zh.ts` / `en.ts`; every other string in those two files comes from `TEXT`.

**Root cause.** The three sites were written before (or outside) the text tables: `suggestedExportName` needs a filename so it uses a literal, the retry helper needs an `Error` so it uses a literal, and the account fallback is exported as a constant used by `accountSessionToUserSession`.

**Expected.** `TEXT.researchPackage.untitledSession` / `TEXT.researchPackage.downloadFailed` (both exist in some form already — `en.ts` has the package section) and a default account name taken from `TEXT.account`. A filename may keep ASCII, but `Solar-session` or the translated label beats `科研会话` for an English user.

**Impact**

- An English user gets a Chinese filename on disk for exactly the sessions that have no title, which is also what they will see in the OS "recent files" list.
- The download failure is the only message explaining that a package did not arrive; in Chinese it is unreadable for that user, and it is raised after retries are exhausted, i.e. at the moment they most need to understand it.
- The account fallback name shows up on the login page and in the signed-in chip, so an English UI can display a Chinese account name for a profile the server did not name.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- ScienceDiscovery desktop client, source `645dc7ba3dde868bf7dcdc6f674e937d42284d3a`.
- Derived from `apps/desktop/src/views/ResearchPackage.tsx:27,81` and `apps/desktop/src/auth/account.ts:33`; not reproduced in a running client (the test host was unavailable at the time).

### Additional Information

- These are the only remaining hardcoded Chinese literals in `apps/desktop/src` outside the text tables (comments excluded) apart from the account page's own formatters, which are reported separately.

### Version Information

- `openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery` @ `645dc7ba3dde868bf7dcdc6f674e937d42284d3a` (main, 2026-11-25).

closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

While a turn is running the permission pill is disabled, so its mode cannot be changed. An evolve design started in 请求批准 (`ask_for_dangerous`) mode therefore stops at its first shell command, and the UI gives no sign that it is waiting for an approval — it keeps showing 正在规划下一步. In my run the design sat like that for **3 hours 31 minutes** until I cancelled the turn.

Steps:
1. New session in the desktop app; leave the permission pill at 请求批准.
2. Type `/evolve-design --algorithm openevolve <task>` and send.
3. The design writes an evaluator, then asks for `Run a shell script in the Session workspace`.
4. Try to switch to 完全访问 while it waits: the pill is `disabled`, `title="这一轮跑完才能切换权限"`.

Observed:
- `GET /api/permission-requests?status=pending` shows the request (`createdAt 2026-11-23T02:11:52.696Z`, summary `Run a shell script in the Session workspace`), still `pending` after 3.5 h.
- The composer shows only 正在规划下一步 and the disabled pill; nothing points at the pending approval, and there is no link or badge to open it.
- Cancelling the turn (`POST /api/sessions/<id>/run/cancel` → 202) then loses the half-written design; the only way forward is to start over with 完全访问.

Expected, any of:
- allow switching the permission mode for subsequent tool calls of the running turn (or offer "allow and switch to 完全访问" on the approval itself), or
- at minimum surface the pending approval prominently (badge/HUD with a link) instead of a passive 正在规划下一步, and keep the request reachable after the turn is cancelled.

Code pointers:
- `apps/desktop/src/views/Composer.tsx:1113` — `title={running ? TEXT.composer.permissionLocked : TEXT.composer.permissionMode}` and the same `running` flag disables the button.
- `apps/desktop/src/text/zh.ts:259` — `permissionLocked: "这一轮跑完才能切换权限"`.

Note: the same lock makes the *documented* evolve workflow fragile, because evolve needs shell runs and the documented setup is to switch to 完全访问 **before** starting the design; if the user forgets, the only feedback is a silent stall.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Product: ScienceDiscovery desktop app (Electron shell around the web UI), Chinese locale `zh-CN`, 1500×950.
- Commit: `a8573558f8c372854079a65906171b3a543b6fb7` (main, 2026-11-22), API `4410` / runner `4411` / evolve sidecar `17676`.
- Session: `fb32e61f-59e3-46d9-a325-2083b3ed3bc2` (the stalled design), pending request id `27b4ceee-b80f-4bd1-9734-f779b24094b3`.
- Evolve runtime `{"state":"ready","canInitialize":false,"sandbox":"bwrap"}`; model Ark DeepSeek.
- Host: Ubuntu 22.04.5, Chromium 1228 + Playwright 1.61.1.

### Additional Information

- Evidence: `~/sd-test/evidence/s205/H1-dialog-auto.png` (the dialog before sending), `J1-dialog.png` (the same dialog after switching to 完全访问 — this path works), plus the pending-request JSON quoted above.
- Workaround used: approve via `POST /api/permission-requests/<id>/decision {"decision":"allow_matching"}` — that resolves it, but the UI never offered it.
- The same applies to any long tool-using turn, not only evolve: the turn cannot be re-scoped mid-flight, so the user must cancel and restart.

### Version Information

- `a8573558f8c372854079a65906171b3a543b6fb7` (main branch, 2026-11-22T15:52:52Z).
