## Summary

When `CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE` is on, `merge_group` runs already send `UT` and the three heavy mocked shards to the self-hosted pool `[self-hosted, Linux, X64, sciencediscovery]`. This PR routes the remaining credential-free Linux L2 jobs there too:

- `ST`
- `L2 E2E (mocked, governed)` and `L2 E2E (mocked, literature)`
- `Desktop UI-ST and mocked E2E`

Pull requests, every other event, hosted runs, credentialed real E2E jobs and distribution jobs are unchanged.

## Why

Merge-queue runs between 05:15 and 07:22 UTC on 2026-11-28 (423 jobs):

| Pool | Average utilisation | Peak concurrency | Queue time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Self-hosted heavy | 28% of 36 runners | 28 | ≈0 (max 0.1 min) |
| Hosted, for the jobs moved here | — | — | median 3.9–6.0 min, max 15.6–20.2 min |

| Job (hosted) | Run (median) | Queue (median / max) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Desktop UI-ST and mocked E2E | 8.7 min | 3.9 / 18.1 min |
| ST | 4.7 min | 5.1 / 15.6 min |
| L2 mocked governed | 3.5 min | 5.4 / 20.2 min |
| L2 mocked literature | 3.2 min | 6.0 / 18.0 min |

The slowest self-hosted L2 job (`standard-config`) takes about 12.7 min. The L2 stage as a whole had a median of 17.7 min and a maximum of 26.3 min. In 5 of the 11 fully green runs, the job that finished L2 last was one of these hosted jobs. The self-hosted pool has since grown to 52 heavy runners across three hosts, so moving these four jobs should bring L2 close to the `standard-config` bound.

## Changes

- `.ci/mocked-matrix.mjs`: `HEAVY_MOCKED_SHARDS` becomes `SELF_HOSTED_MOCKED_SHARDS` and lists all five mocked shards. A newly added shard stays hosted until someone lists it.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:
  - `st` and `desktop-mocked` use `runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(needs.policy.outputs.ut_runner) }}`, the same policy output and pool as UT.
  - Both drop the remote `cache: pnpm` on the self-hosted path; `st` also drops the uv cache.
  - `st` provisions bubblewrap with `sudo` only when `bwrap` does not already work, using the same check as UT and the mocked E2E job.
  - On self-hosted, `st` skips `actions/cache` for the verified CPython archive and points `BINARY_CACHE_DIR` at the persistent `/ci-cache/binary-cache`. `fetch-runtime.mjs` already creates that directory and stages each write before renaming it into place.
  - On self-hosted, `desktop-mocked` runs `playwright install chromium` without `--with-deps`. The runner image already carries Chromium's system libraries and grants no `sudo`.
- `.ci/self-hosted-merge-queue.test.mjs`: the contract now expects all five shards to be routed, and checks the new routing, cache and no-sudo wiring for `st` and `desktop-mocked`. `docker` and the binary jobs must stay hosted.
- `.ci/README.md`: the self-hosted routing section lists the new jobs and what stays hosted.

## Validation

- `node --test .ci/*.test.mjs`: 246 tests, 246 passed, 0 failed.
- `pnpm ci:l1`: PASS, planned 4, executed 4, passed 4.
- `pnpm ci:selftest`: passed.
- `pnpm docs:check`: passed (148 Markdown files).
- The four moved jobs, reproduced at `main` `a19476ae2` inside temporary containers. Each container used the self-hosted runner image and the same container options as the registered runners, was not registered with GitHub, and ran the steps as this workflow now runs them on self-hosted (no `sudo`, no remote caches, local `/ci-cache`):

  | Job | Result | Wall time incl. clone and install |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | ST (`pnpm ci:st -- --profile merge --coverage`) | PASS 69/69 | 4.2 min |
  | mocked `governed` (`pnpm ci:e2e -- --profile merge --shard governed`) | PASS 5/5 | 2.1 min |
  | mocked `literature` (`--shard literature`) | PASS 6/6 | 2.0 min |
  | Desktop: `run-desktop-e2e.mjs ui-st` and `mocked` with `CI_DESKTOP_SPECS=all`, `CI_DESKTOP_PROFILE=merge` | 14 passed + 254 passed, 0 failed | 4.9 min |

- UT and the other mocked shards were not re-run on this commit: the change only touches CI orchestration, and those jobs keep their existing routing.

## E2E user journeys

Not applicable as a product change. No user-observable behaviour changes. The journeys these jobs run were executed unchanged on the self-hosted image as listed above.

## Risk and rollout

- This changes the CI contract (workflow routing), so it needs maintainer confirmation.
- Self-hosted runners only receive trusted `merge_group` runs. The policy fails closed to `ubuntu-latest` for `pull_request`, forks and every other event.
- Rollback: unset or change `CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE`. Newly created merge-queue runs then go back to `ubuntu-latest`; runs that were already queued for self-hosted labels need to be cancelled and re-queued.

## Release

Release category: release:internal

User impact: none; merge-queue validation runs on different runners.

Compatibility and migration: no migration. The self-hosted runners already provide `/ci-cache`, bubblewrap and Chromium's system libraries.

A pull request that changes something a reader can see is approved on the frames, not on the diff, and neither the contributor guide nor the PR skill asked for them. CONTRIBUTING.md sends UI changes to "browser coverage" and its screenshot language is about per-step journey reports; the create-github-pr skill names no screenshot at all. In practice a reviewer asks for the frames one round after opening the pull request, and a rename that missed one locale can pass because nobody asked for the other half.

This states the requirement in the two places read before opening a pull request, and keeps the frames where review evidence belongs — outside the repository. The owner chose that explicitly: frames are evidence for the review, not artifacts of the change.

## CONTRIBUTING.md

A new `### UI changes need screenshots` subsection under *Opening a pull request*, with five points and one limit:

- frames go in the body, not only in a review comment that the next push detaches;
- before and after of the same view, same window and crop; a surface that did not exist before is shown next to the closest state that did;
- both `zh-CN` and `en`, because the two dictionaries are separate strings and a rename reaches one of them;
- **not committed**: hosted on a branch in the contributor's fork or at another URL that does not change, and embedded from there — pinned to a commit SHA when that URL comes from a git branch, because a branch moves and the body silently starts showing something else. The frames already under `docs/screenshots/` are named as history rather than as the model, with the reason: a frame committed by mistake stays in history after the pull request is reverted;
- a caption under each frame (surface, viewport and device scale, harness, what is mocked, which copy comes from the diff), and redaction of keys, tokens, absolute paths and hostnames.

The limit is stated rather than implied: screenshots are review evidence and no CI check reads them, so a change with no rendered surface says so in one line and skips the section.

## .agents/skills/create-github-pr/SKILL.md

- Rule 8 puts the requirement beside the other body rules and says where the images live.
- The body template gains a `## UI screenshots` section between the E2E section and `## Release`, so an agent writing a body has somewhere to put the frames instead of inventing a heading.
- A paragraph after the template explains the same-view/same-crop point, the commit-pinning trap (a branch moves and the body silently shows something else), why the images stay out of the tree, redaction, and that the guide is the wording of record — the skill repeats it because an agent reads that file and not the guide.

## One comment that contradicted the rule

`apps/desktop/e2e/network-allowlist.spec.ts` told a run to copy the frames it writes into `docs/screenshots/1399/` as the pull request's evidence. Now that evidence stays outside the tree, that comment says so; the capture behaviour is untouched.

## Validation

Docs only; no test layer applies. `markdownlint-cli2 CONTRIBUTING.md .agents/skills/create-github-pr/SKILL.md`, using the repository's `.markdownlint-cli2.jsonc`, reports `0 issues in 0 files` across the 176 files it matched.

The configuration's globs cover `CONTRIBUTING.md` and do **not** cover `.agents/**/*.md`, so the skill file is linted only because it is passed on the command line; `pnpm docs:lint` on its own would not lint it. A control run shows the explicit path is honoured rather than ignored: adding a second blank line to the skill file makes the same command fail with `MD012/no-multiple-blanks` at `SKILL.md:62`, and removing it returns the run to `0 issues`.

The cross-references were checked by reading the files: `CONTRIBUTING.md#ui-changes-need-screenshots` matches the new heading, and `../../../CONTRIBUTING.md` from `.agents/skills/create-github-pr/` resolves to the repository root guide.

The claims the text makes about the tree were checked against `main` = `cb18c534` rather than against this branch's older base: `docs/screenshots` has twelve entries there, which is why the paragraph names no number; `.ci/changed-paths.mjs` still classifies `docs/` as documentation.

## E2E user journeys

not applicable — no user-observable product path changes; the diff is two Markdown files and one comment.

## Release
Release category: release:docs
User impact: none at runtime. Contributors and agents get one explicit requirement instead of discovering it in review.
Compatibility and migration: none.

## Changes
- `store/sandbox-network.ts`: every validation rejection now carries the stable code `INVALID_SANDBOX_NETWORK_SETTINGS` via one helper. This covers non-record bodies, unknown fields, mode, allowedDomains, allowPrivateNetwork, the empty/open allowlist checks, domain parsing, and the egressProxyPolicy validator. Every message is unchanged.
- `http/index.ts`: the catch-all maps that code to `400` with the store's own sentence, beside `INVALID_WEB_SETTINGS`. Only validation is tagged: a catalog write failure in the same save still answers 500 and still logs `unclassified_request_error`.
- No handler-wide wrapping and no change to `subagent-brief` copy.

## Validation

An injected persistence fault in the same route still answers 500 and is logged.
- The same new test failed on the unfixed code (3 cases: `500 !== 400`) and passes 5/5 after the fix.

API journey PASS: the public route was exercised over a real socket for the three failing bodies, the 200 control and the persistence-fault case. Browser journeys BLOCKED: bwrap is not installed in this workspace and the mocked browser subset has no journey for this admin settings route.

## What

Deletes `docs/screenshots/` from the tree: **14 directories, 95 files, 8,327,474 bytes (about 7.9 MiB)** at `main` = `e374837d`. Deletions only; no file is added, edited or moved.

| directory | files | bytes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `1266` | 3 | 150,415 |
| `1275` | 11 | 1,075,382 |
| `1302` | 8 | 39,172 |
| `1305` | 12 | 1,728,536 |
| `1313` | 7 | 572,997 |
| `1330` | 5 | 466,889 |
| `1349` | 8 | 634,426 |
| `1398` | 5 | 761,074 |
| `1399` | 7 | 178,474 |
| `1401` | 3 | 257,918 |
| `1412` | 2 | 36,940 |
| `1440` | 7 | 634,624 |
| `proxy-settings-ui` | 11 | 1,405,697 |
| `setup-wizard-button-radius` | 6 | 384,930 |

Of the 95 files, 79 are `.png`, 6 are `.jpg` and 10 are the `README.md` files that describe the older sets. This includes `1440`, added on 2026-11-27 (18:04:07Z) — the most recent committed set.

## Why

#1477 records the convention that UI frames are review evidence, not repository artifacts: they are hosted outside the tree at a URL that does not change, embedded in the pull request body, and pinned to a commit SHA when that URL comes from a branch. Those directories are history rather than the rule, and the tree still carries that history. Git keeps every one of them: each blob stays reachable from the commit that added it, so this change removes them from the current tree without losing them.

## What this does not break, checked rather than assumed

- **In-tree references: exactly one.** `apps/desktop/e2e/network-allowlist.spec.ts:48` is the only file on `main` that names a path under `docs/screenshots/`, in the comment "The screenshots each run writes are copied unchanged into `docs/screenshots/1399/`…". I downloaded and grepped the contents of all 1,034 text files on `main` (`.md`, `.mjs`, `.json`, `.yml`, `.yaml`, `.sh`, `.py`, `.txt`, `.html`, `.spec.ts`, and `.ts`/`.tsx` under `scripts/` or `e2e/`). Several files discuss screenshots in general — `.ci/README.md`, `.agents/skills/frontend-quality/{SKILL.md,references/*}`, `docs/en/design/desktop-mcp-controls.v2.md`, `docs/en/developer-docs/frontend-quality.md` among them — and every one of those mentions the word, not this path: no link, no path, nothing that resolves into the directory. There is also no index `README.md` at `docs/screenshots/`.
- **The one comment is comment-only and does not read this directory.** It says a run copies its captures there for review evidence; no test reads or writes those files, so the capture behaviour is unchanged by deleting them. #1477 already rewrites that same comment (`:47-49`) to say the frames are attached to the pull request.
- **Pull request bodies: none point into `main`.** Of the 116 pull requests that mention `docs/screenshots`, I read every body: no body links or embeds a path on `main`/`master`. Recent ones embed frames from a fork branch or from an upstream commit SHA (for example `…/3df4eb11…/docs/screenshots/1503/…`), and those keep resolving because the commits still exist.

## The guide's wording is a follow-up, not part of this change

#1477 adds a `### UI changes need screenshots` section to `CONTRIBUTING.md` whose two sentences describe these directories as still present:

> Some directories under `docs/screenshots/` still hold frames committed by earlier changes; that is history, not the rule…

> Some of the committed directories kept that in a `README.md`; the rest left it in the pull request that added them…

After this change both clauses describe directories that no longer exist. Those lines are **not on `main` yet** — #1477 introduces them — so editing them here would race that pull request on the same file for no benefit. So this PR deliberately does not touch `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and the wording correction follows in a separate change once #1477 has landed: both sentences move to the past tense (planned: "…held frames committed by earlier changes…" and "The directories that held committed frames kept that in a `README.md`…"). Until then the guide is no more wrong than it is today, and after this change it is wrong only about the tense.

## Verification for this head

- Merge base is `main` = `e374837d`; the branch is one commit that changes no file except the 95 deletions.
- The tree I built was diffed against `main` before pushing: `docs/screenshots/` has no remaining entry, and no other path changed (the `docs` tree node's own sha moves, which is the consequence of its child changing).
- No test suite applies to deleting documentation image files; the reference audit above is the evidence, and its inputs are named so it can be repeated.

Updates Desktop Specialist management to the user-provided 2026-11-26 design, following merged #1377 and #1180. Scope is Specialist management only; Skills/MCP management remain references.

## Validation

Current PR head `e4eeec94` includes main `a70ef94c`. The Specialist capability hints use the shared contrast token in both selection states. The English case later lost its settings menu while the composer was being replaced after loading. The follow-up waits for the session welcome page before opening the menu. All executed jobs passed, including L1, UT, ST, Desktop UI-ST, both mocked L2 shards, coverage, Docker, both binaries and merge-gate. GitCode CodeCheck and CLA passed. Installer jobs and real E2E layers were skipped by policy. The desktop files tested on `04cd5e24` are identical on `5dffafd4`. Those focused runs passed 70 unit tests and two browser cases for the Chinese and English Specialist skill drawer.
- [Hosted CI for `4243ed79`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/45950876319) passed on its second attempt. The first attempt failed in the Idea Tree resume journey after a model request returned `401 Unauthorized`; both Specialist desktop journeys passed in that attempt.

Session creation refuses new bindings to a Specialist disabled after selection. Existing bindings are retained. ## What changed
`apps/desktop/e2e/panel-interactions.spec.ts` only: the 版本 picker assertion no longer compares the rows to the exact strings `["v3","v2","v1"]`. Each row now matches `/^vN(?:当前会话 · \d{2}:\d{2})?$/u`, so the journey keeps checking the version number and the row order while tolerating the optional producer/time meta the picker gained for same-named versions. The `aria-checked` check on v3 and the v2 click are unchanged.

## Why
Merge-queue run **46106158736**, job "Desktop UI-ST and mocked E2E" **140859771443** (step "Run selected Desktop mocked specs"), failed only here: expected `["v3","v2","v1"]`, received `["v3当前会话 · 09:30","v2当前会话 · 09:30","v1当前会话 · 09:30"]`, `1 failed / 252 passed`, retry identical. That batch commit (1d2c8726de) carried the queued version-label UI from PR #1309. Main e374837d3 still renders bare `v{version}`, so requiring the marker would fail on main; the assertion must hold on both UI states, hence the optional group. PR #1411 does not touch this spec or the version picker, so the failure blocked its queue entry and is not its regression. The marker's own wording/format belongs to the render test; this expectation only rejects arbitrary row text.

## Verification (local, mocked desktop layer)
`CI=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$PWD/.e2e/browsers apps/desktop/e2e/node_modules/.bin/playwright test --config apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts panel-interactions.spec.ts`
- Baseline main, old assertion: **12 passed**
- WorkspacePanel.tsx + design.css from 1d2c8726de, old assertion: **1 failed / 11 passed**, same received strings as the job
- Same UI, fixed assertion: **12 passed**
- Restored main UI, fixed assertion: **12 passed**
- Anchored regex check: accepts bare `vN` and `vN当前会话 · HH:MM`, rejects `v3其他会话 · 09:30`, `v3当前会话 · 9:30`, `v3 当前会话 · 09:30`, `v4`, empty. `node test/check-e2e-meta.mjs`: 139 specs, 0 errors.

Risk: none outside the spec; the clock is not hard-coded, ordering and the selected row are still asserted.

### 测试

```
CI=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$PWD/.e2e/browsers apps/desktop/e2e/node_modules/.bin/playwright test --config apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts panel-interactions.spec.ts
```

recent_merged.body:
## Summary

Refs #1360

When GitHub-hosted Linux runner capacity is congested, even short credential-free decision, planning, accounting, and gate jobs in the merge queue (`policy`, `l1`, `e2e-plan`, `coverage`, `merge-gate`, `real-plan`, `real-report`) can sit queued behind hosted runner availability.

This PR adds opt-in merge-queue routing for those seven lightweight jobs to dedicated self-hosted light runner slots (`[self-hosted, Linux, X64, sciencediscovery-light]`), kept separate from the heavy test-runner pool (`sciencediscovery`) so control/gate jobs never contend with long-running UT/E2E shards or hosted runner queues.

### Key Changes

- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`**:
  - Route `policy` to `["self-hosted","Linux","X64","sciencediscovery-light"]` when `github.event_name == 'merge_group' && vars.CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE == 'true'`; otherwise keep `ubuntu-latest`.
  - Route downstream policy-dependent lightweight jobs (`l1`, `e2e-plan`, `coverage`, `merge-gate`) via `needs.policy.outputs.self_hosted_merge_queue == 'true'` (single source of truth matching #1361's `ut`/`e2e` routing; safely falls back to `ubuntu-latest` if `policy` fails).
  - Disable cross-region `actions/setup-node@v4` `cache: pnpm` on `l1` and `e2e-plan` when `needs.policy.outputs.self_hosted_merge_queue == 'true'` so they reuse the container's local `/ci-cache` pnpm/npm stores directly.
  - Leave `ut`, `st`, `e2e`, `desktop-mocked`, `binary`, `docker`, `windows-desktop`, and `macos-desktop` untouched in this PR.
- **`.github/workflows/real-e2e.yml`**:
  - Route `real-plan` and `real-report` to `["self-hosted","Linux","X64","sciencediscovery-light"]` only when `github.event_name == 'merge_group' && vars.CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE == 'true'`; otherwise keep `ubuntu-latest`.
  - Disable remote `actions/setup-node@v4` `cache: pnpm` on `real-plan` when routed to a light slot.
  - Keep credentialed `real-e2e` and `desktop-real` workers strictly on `ubuntu-latest`.
- **`.ci/self-hosted-light-jobs.test.mjs`**:
  - Add contract tests evaluating the actual `runs-on` and `cache` workflow expressions across `merge_group`, `pull_request`, `workflow_dispatch`, `schedule`, and `push` with `CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE` unset, empty, `'false'`, `'TRUE'`, `'1'`, and `'true'`, feeding real `tier-policy.mjs` `route()` outputs into `needs.policy.outputs.self_hosted_merge_queue` (plus a failed-`policy` fallback check for `merge-gate`).
  - Dynamically derive the complement of all other parsed jobs with `runs-on` across `ci.yml` and `real-e2e.yml` to assert none of them reference `sciencediscovery-light`, assert the seven routed jobs target `sciencediscovery-light` (not bare `sciencediscovery`), assert none of them reference `secrets.`, and confirm `real-plan`/`real-report` retain `github.event_name != 'pull_request'`.
- **`.ci/self-hosted-merge-queue.test.mjs`**:
  - Update the post-#1361 contract test so `l1`, `e2e-plan`, `coverage`, and `merge-gate` are asserted to route via `needs.policy.outputs.self_hosted_merge_queue` to `sciencediscovery-light` (while keeping `st`, `desktop-mocked`, and `docker` strictly pinned to `ubuntu-latest` and preserving `doesNotMatch /vars\.CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE/` on `e2e-plan`).
- **`.ci/README.md`**:
  - Document the shared `CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE` toggle, light-runner container deployment steps (`RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE=/opt/hostedtoolcache` + `x64.complete` marker for pinned Node, `/ci-cache` env vars, `--labels sciencediscovery-light`, `/ci-cache` warm-up before enabling so `l1` stays within its 10-minute timeout, enablement order), safety boundaries, and exact outage recovery steps.

### Safety & Rollback

- **Default off**: Without repository variable `CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE=true`, all seven jobs remain on `ubuntu-latest` with zero behavioral change.
- **Strict event boundary**: `pull_request` (including forks), `workflow_dispatch`, `schedule`, and `push` always stay on `ubuntu-latest`, even when `CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE=true`.
- **Credential isolation**: None of the seven light jobs inject any `secrets.*`; model credentials remain strictly confined to GitHub-hosted `real-e2e` and `desktop-real` jobs.
- **Rollback and outage recovery**: Because GitHub Actions evaluates `runs-on` when a job is queued, unsetting or changing `CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE` returns all **newly created** `merge_group` runs to `ubuntu-latest`. During a light-runner outage, clear `CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE` first and then cancel and re-run affected `merge_group` runs already queued on `sciencediscovery-light` (or re-enqueue PRs ejected by the merge queue).

## Verification

- **YAML syntax**: `python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml')); yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/real-e2e.yml'))"` -> OK
- **Targeted self-hosted contract tests**:
  - `node --test .ci/self-hosted-merge-queue.test.mjs` -> 8 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
  - `node --test .ci/self-hosted-light-jobs.test.mjs` -> 3 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
- **All `.ci` unit/contract tests**: `node --test .ci/*.test.mjs` -> 245 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
- **L1 & docs checks**:
  - `pnpm ci:l1` -> 4/4 passed (`status: PASS`, 0 failed, 0 skipped)
  - `pnpm docs:check` -> `markdownlint-cli2` 0 issues; `check-doc-links.mjs` passed
  - `node .ci/test-selector.mjs check` -> OK
  - `node scripts/check-architecture.mjs` -> OK
  - `node test/check-e2e-meta.mjs` -> 0 errors
  - `CI_ENFORCE_SOURCE_MAP=1 node .ci/changed-path-check.mjs` -> OK (0/0 mapped)
- **Self-hosted 4 GiB light-container smoke test** (`sd-actions-runner:local`, `--memory=4g`, warm `/ci-cache` mounted):
  - Clone: 6s; `policy` (`tier-policy.mjs`): <1s; `l1` (`pnpm ci:l1`, 409/409 pnpm packages reused from `/ci-cache`, 4/4 PASS): 12s; `e2e-plan` (195 mocked identities, 5 workers): 5s; `real-plan` (9 real identities, 1 worker): 1s; `self-hosted-light-jobs.test.mjs` (3/3 PASS): <1s
  - Combined wall time: 24s; peak container memory (`cgroup memory.peak`): 1.70 GiB / 4.00 GiB limit
- **Not run locally**: Full L2 UT/ST/E2E/distribution matrix (covered by PR CI on GitHub Actions; `CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE` is off on PR runs and `pull_request` never enters the self-hosted branch).

Release category: release:internal

Export could authorize a stale preview, keep polling after the dialog had given up, and report a revision-change failure as "Operation failed".

## What changed
Start export now requires the preview to match the current selection, so a failed or pending recalculation keeps the last estimate (#1057) without authorizing an export; each card stops after six pending answers and restarts on retry; both revision-change sentences map to one localized line; the over-cap key carries the selection. Rebased onto main@e63099ab.

## Frames
The over-cap frame prints `RESEARCH_PACKAGE_MAX_BYTES` (5 GiB default) against a 6 GiB selection, so the dialog's `formatBytes` reads 未压缩上限：5.0 GB; the en "Not included" line still falls below the scroll fold. Both stills are commit-pinned:

![Stalled recalculation, zh-CN, at 2be03a75](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/raw/2be03a75f51a0f5eaa65ee175ea2bef45b0a83d7/docs/screenshots/1440/01-stalled-recalculation-zh-3919db5.png)
![Over-limit re-acknowledged, zh-CN, at fbde0829](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/raw/fbde0829ddbb6de95bfaf3df46cf8682dcf608de/docs/screenshots/1440/03-over-limit-reacknowledged-zh-2be03a75.png)

## Provenance, per reviews 6091727931, 6091780882, 6091862075, 6091897542
The six frames are named after `2be03a75`, the commit that added them; only the names changed, with identical blob IDs across the `git mv`. The README shows the six 100% renames and unchanged code, lists only what `2be03a75` contains (images, spec, zh/en copy, `ResearchPackage.tsx`, trim test, README), and notes that the frames use the fixture the branch already had. `3919db5` appears nowhere.

## Validation
Unit 1808/0 (trim 28/28), typecheck clean, mocked spec 6 passed at `2be03a75`; pre-fix 19/9 and 6/6 fail. Gates on this head: `check-e2e-meta` 139 specs / 0 errors, `docs:links` 156 files, `docs:lint` 185 files / 0 issues; only README and PR text changed, so UT/ST were not re-run. release:fix, no compatibility change.

Closes #1440

### 测试

```
pnpm docs:check && node test/check-e2e-meta.mjs
```
